items.title: Okinawa chiefs don covers, receive anchors
items.author: PO2 Zachary Guth
items.summary: Okinawa welcomed its newest members to the rank of chief petty officer at Keystone Theater on Kadena Air Base on Sept. 16, 2026. Nineteen Sailors were pinned to chief petty officer alongside five U.S. Marines and one U.S. Air Force Airman as honorary chief petty officers.
items.body:
KADENA AIR BASE, Japan – Okinawa welcomed its newest members to the rank of chief petty officer at Keystone Theater on Kadena Air Base on Sept. 16, 2026. Nineteen Sailors were pinned to chief petty officer alongside five U.S. Marines and one U.S. Air Force Airman as honorary chief petty officers.

The chief pinning ceremony represents the culminations of six weeks of physical, mental and emotional training. Families and mentors were welcomed on stage to pin the fouled anchor onto the new chiefs and don them with the chief petty officer cover. For the first time in their career, they bear the uniform of a chief petty officer.

“Six weeks did not magically turn you into a chief. A chief is built, with time, with mistakes, long nights, hard lessons, difficult conversations, and repeated reminders that the job is bigger than your ego,” said Command Master Chief Frank Queenlacombe, Naval Mobile Construction Battalion 5 senior enlisted leader, during his remarks. “Today is not the finish line. It is your second beginning, your second birthday.”

Two of the 19 Sailors selected for promotion to chief petty officer on Okinawa belong to Commander, Fleet Activities Okinawa’s security department.

“I am incredibly grateful to reach this milestone at CFAO, surrounded by fellow chiefs and officers who have made a lasting impact on my career and the Sailor I have become,” said Chief Master-at-Arms Brandon Hodges. “I wouldn’t be here without the people who have believed in me, pushed me to grow and supported me throughout this journey. Their guidance and support have meant more to me than I can put into words.”

In total the chief pinning ceremony brought together six naval commands across the island of Okinawa, along with the five Marine commands and one Air Force command. Together, they forged their leadership, their ideals, communicated with their mentorship and laid the groundwork for a new chapter in their lives.

“You don’t change who you are because you become a chief, it only enhances you,” said newly pinned Chief Sonar Technician (Submarines) Tony Holman, assigned to Navy Data Center Detachment Okinawa. “You go from being a leader by yourself, to understanding that you can’t do it alone. That you’re not a chief to just your Sailors but to everybody.”

The Navy rank of chief petty officer holds special regard amongst the U.S Armed Forces, a tradition going back 133 years, with those selected moving into roles of great responsibility and leadership. With the striking of two bells and the whistle of the boatswain’s pipe, the chiefs carry the weight of the anchor as they salute the side boys for the first time.

“The chief petty officer pinning is a public display of an outward, visible dedication—an acceptance of the responsibility to provide servant leadership to the sons and daughters whom we are entrusted to lead into harm’s way every day,’ said Command Master Chief Aaron Belcher, Commander, Fleet Activities Okinawa senior enlisted leader, after the pinning ceremony. “We achieved this through the support of everyone along our journey and the relentless hard work of our Sailors.”

He concluded, “Ultimately, the pinning ceremony provides total transparency into the expectations of a chief, serving as a public dedication to being present, meaningful leaders on the deck plates."
zhParas: 日本嘉手纳空军基地——2026年9月16日，冲绳在嘉手纳空军基地基斯通剧院欢迎最新一批晋升为海军三级军士长的人员。19名水兵与5名美国海军陆战队员和1名美国空军士兵一同获授海军三级军士长军衔，后者作为荣誉海军三级军士长。
海军三级军士长授衔仪式标志着为期六周的身体、心理和情感训练的圆满结束。家属和导师受邀登台，为新晋军士长别上缠锚徽章，并为他们戴上军士长军帽。这是他们职业生涯中第一次穿上海军三级军士长制服。
“六周并没有神奇地把你变成军士长。军士长是锻造出来的，需要时间、错误、长夜、深刻教训、艰难对话，以及反复提醒自己：职责大于个人自尊，”海军第5机动建筑营高级士兵顾问、司令军士长弗兰克·昆拉科姆（Frank Queenlacombe）在致辞中表示。“今天不是终点线，而是你们的第二个起点、第二个生日。”
在冲绳被选拔晋升为海军三级军士长的19名水兵中，有两人隶属驻冲绳海军舰队活动司令部安全部门。
“我无比感激能在CFAO迎来这一里程碑，身边有那些对我的职业生涯和我今天成为的水兵产生持久影响的军士长同僚和军官，”海军三级军士长兼纠察布兰登·霍奇斯（Brandon Hodges）说。“如果没有那些相信我、推动我成长并在这段旅程中支持我的人，我不会有今天。他们的指导和支持对我来说意义重大，难以言表。”
此次军士长授衔仪式总共汇聚了冲绳岛上的六个海军司令部，以及五个海军陆战队司令部和一个空军司令部。他们共同锤炼领导力和理想，在导师指导下交流，并为人生新篇章奠定基础。
“你不会因为成为军士长而改变自己，这只会提升你，”新晋海军三级军士长、声呐技术员（潜艇）托尼·霍尔曼（Tony Holman）说，他派驻海军数据中心冲绳分遣队。“你会从独自做领导者，转变为明白自己不能单打独斗；明白你不只是自己水兵的军士长，而是所有人的军士长。”
美国海军三级军士长军衔在美军中备受尊崇，这一传统可追溯至133年前，获选者将走上责任重大、需要发挥领导作用的岗位。伴随着两声钟响和水手长哨声，军士长们首次向舷侧仪仗兵敬礼，肩负起锚徽章所承载的重任。
“海军三级军士长授衔仪式是一种公开展示，体现着一种外在、可见的奉献——即接受这样的责任：为那些我们每天受托带领赴险的儿女们提供服务型领导，”驻冲绳舰队活动司令部高级士官、指挥军士长亚伦·贝尔彻（Aaron Belcher）在授衔仪式后表示。“我们之所以做到这一点，靠的是一路上所有人的支持，以及我们水兵的不懈努力。”
他总结道：“归根结底，授衔仪式完全透明地展现了对一名海军三级军士长的期望，也是一种公开承诺：要在甲板一线成为亲临现场、有实际作为的领导者。”

items.title: MAG-24 Marines train with Army, Air Force to rapidly repair damaged airfields
items.author: Sgt Anabelle Reedobrien
items.summary: MARINE CORPS TRAINING AREA BELLOWS, Hawaii — Sept. 14-17, 2026, service members from Marine Wing Support Squadron 174, Marine Aircraft Group 24 trained with the Army’s 130th Engineer Brigade and the Air Force’s 647th Civil Engineer Squadron to sharpen the joint force's ability to rapidly repair damaged airfields. This joint training strengthened interoperability and readiness, enhancing the U.S. military's ability to operate in austere environments.
items.body:
MARINE CORPS TRAINING AREA BELLOWS, Hawaii — Sept. 14-17, 2026, service members from Marine Wing Support Squadron 174, Marine Aircraft Group 24 trained with the Army’s 130th Engineer Brigade and the Air Force’s 647th Civil Engineer Squadron to sharpen the joint force's ability to rapidly repair damaged airfields. This joint training strengthened interoperability and readiness, enhancing the U.S. military's ability to operate in austere environments.

Runways are critical to aviation operations in any environment. During a crisis, the speed that repair crews respond can determine how quickly flight operations resume. This joint airfield damage repair (JADR) exercise involved a realistic scenario with service members assessing and repairing large craters simulating the kind of damage that may be encountered in contested environments. After assessing and clearing out the damaged areas, service members used a special form of rapid-setting cement to repair the simulated craters.

“This training impacts the Marine Corps in a lot of ways,” said 2nd Lt. Zachary Kolb, JADR officer in charge, with MWSS-174. “Working with partnered forces prepares us for future operations while giving the Marines a realistic exercise that covers all aspects of airfield damage repair.”

While technical proficiency was a key focus, the broader value was in standardizing the process across military branches and preparing participants for future operations. Participating units coordinated their efforts through a shared command post, emphasizing teamwork alongside technical proficiency. The joint structure enabled the services to align planning, streamline communications and synchronize their distinct technical procedures.

“It’s always a great experience working with different branches,” said Lance Cpl. Mark Rummel, a combat engineer, with MWSS-174. “It's eye-opening to learn how they operate and their unique strategy for getting the mission done.”

As the dust settled over Marine Corps Training Area Bellows, Marines, soldiers and Airmen packed their gear with a clearer understanding of how their specialized capabilities support the joint force. By working together to solve complex logistical challenges, they refined a standardized approach to repairing damaged airfields giving commanders more reliable options to rapidly restore flight operations and project airpower from remote locations in contested environments.
zhParas: 夏威夷海军陆战队贝洛斯训练区——2026年9月14日至17日，来自海军陆战队第24航空大队第174航空支援中队的军人，与陆军第130工兵旅和空军第647土木工程中队共同训练，以提升联合部队快速修复受损机场的能力。此次联合训练增强了互操作性和战备，提升了美军在艰苦环境中作战的能力。
跑道在任何环境中都对航空行动至关重要。危机期间，抢修人员的响应速度可以决定飞行行动恢复的速度。此次联合机场损伤修复（JADR）演习设置了逼真的想定，军人评估并修复大型弹坑，模拟在争夺环境中可能遭遇的那类损伤。在评估并清理受损区域后，军人使用一种特殊的速凝水泥修复模拟弹坑。
“这次训练以多种方式影响海军陆战队，”MWSS-174 的 JADR 负责人 2nd Lt. 扎卡里·科尔布（Zachary Kolb）说。“与伙伴部队合作使我们为未来行动做好准备，同时让海军陆战队员参加一场涵盖机场损伤修复所有方面的逼真演习。”
虽然技术熟练度是一个重点，但更广泛的价值在于使跨军种流程标准化，并为参与者未来行动做好准备。参演部队通过共用指挥所协调行动，在强调技术熟练度的同时突出团队合作。联合架构使各军种能够统一规划、简化沟通并同步各自不同的技术程序。
“与不同军种合作总是很棒的体验，”MWSS-174 的战斗工兵 Lance Cpl. 马克·鲁梅尔（Mark Rummel）说。“了解他们如何运作以及他们完成任务所采用的独特策略，令人大开眼界。”
随着尘土在海军陆战队贝洛斯训练区落定，海军陆战队员、陆军士兵和空军人员收拾装备，更加清楚地认识到他们的专业能力如何支援联合部队。通过共同解决复杂的后勤挑战，他们完善了一套标准化的受损机场修复方法，使指挥官拥有更可靠的选项，以便在对抗环境中从偏远地点迅速恢复飞行行动并投射空中力量。

items.title: Experts: Affordable Munitions Could Help USAF in Taiwan Conflict, but More Is Needed
items.author: Todd South
items.summary: A new think tank report calls for a buildup of U.S. drones and munitions needed for a potential fight against the Chinese military over Taiwan, thought other experts argue the report is missing some nuance in the munitions equation. The post Experts: Affordable Munitions Could Help USAF in Taiwan Conflict, but More Is Needed appeared first on Air & Space Forces Magazine .
items.body:
A new think tank report calls for a buildup of U.S. drones and munitions needed for a potential fight against the Chinese military over Taiwan, though other experts argue the report is missing some nuance in the munitions equation.

The Center for a New American Security’s report, “Drones, Missiles, and the U.S. Munitions Shortage: The Role of Affordable Mass in a Taiwan Conflict,” released Sept. 18, makes the case for increased long-range weapons to strike Chinese military targets to thwart a takeover of Taiwan.

The report, authored by Philip Sheers and Stacie Pettyjohn, notes a gap between the number of targets the U.S. would need to strike and its diminishing stockpiles, given the ongoing use of such weapons in the conflict with Iran.

“In a U.S.-China conflict over Taiwan that is likely to become protracted, the inventory depth and disruption that lower-cost systems can provide will be invaluable to reversing U.S. disadvantages and stopping China from achieving its operational objectives,” Sheers and Pettyjohn write.

To close the gap, the report recommends both stockpiling high-end missiles and massing cheap drones and munitions to overwhelm a Chinese attack. Other recommendations include:

- Multiyear funding and contracts so manufacturers can expand weapons production capacity and the Pentagon can rebuild long-range missile stores

- Funding for cheap, long-range anti-ship and land-attack weapons to quickly fill inventory gaps.

- Standardized shared components across airframes to lower costs and scale production.

- Pairing inexpensive drones with advanced missiles to drain enemy air defenses.

- Prioritizing easily built designs rather than over-engineering

- Routine updates and briefings to Congress on these issues

The White House and Pentagon have taken steps to boost munitions production this year, especially low-cost weapons.

In July, the Pentagon announced multiyear framework agreements with Anduril, CoAspire, and Zone 5 Technologies to mass-produce missiles for the Air Force, followed by a Sept. 17 announcement that Lockheed Martin would expand production of the AIM-260 Joint Advanced Tactical Missile.

The former announcement is part of USAF’s Family of Affordable Mass Missiles program, unveiled in the fiscal 2026 budget with plans to ramp up such production to hit 5,300 missiles a year by 2028 and reach nearly 8,000 missiles a year by 2031.

The current projected five-year budget for FAMM is more than $12 billion for nearly 27,000 missiles.

Retired Air Force Col. Mark Gunzinger, now with AFA’s Mitchell Institute for Aerospace Studies, told Air & Space Forces Magazine that the CNAS report’s call for more munitions is necessary. But he cautioned that the report’s focus on making weapons affordable needs to be tweaked.

“It should not be about buying cheaper weapons; it should be about how to optimize cost per effect in the battlespace,” Gunzinger said.

The Air Force must fight asymmetrically and maximize the effect of each strike, regardless of munition or platform, and there’s a middle ground for weapons and platform development and procurement, Gunzinger argued.

Precision-guided, specialized weapons such as the Long-Range Anti-Ship Missile and the platforms that deliver them are pricey, and lower-end, short-range munitions for stationary targets have their place, but Gunzinger said defense planners can often make too much of a tradeoff if they focus too much on price to the detriment of capability.

“Now you’ve got something that, ‘OK, you hit a price point, but is it going to survive long enough to do its mission?’” Gunzinger said. “Is it going to be able to shoot its weapon before it dies?”

A Numbers Game

The CNAS report’s operational and tactical focus is countering a People’s Liberation Army attack on Taiwan with strikes against PLA ships—destroyers and amphibious assault ships—and hitting airfields on the periphery of the country, close to the Taiwan Strait.

But it does not include a plan to hit the Chinese mainland interior.

“The paper focuses on denying a PLA joint island landing campaign without considering strategic attacks to deny sanctuaries to the PLA and collapse China’s ability to maintain the offensive,” Gunzinger said. “This risks reducing a conflict with the PLA over Taiwan to a force-on-force math problem, like how many weapons and aircraft are needed to attack PLA forces located in the Taiwan Strait and coastal China. It risks becoming a numbers game.”

Because striking mainland China in a Taiwan invasion scenario might be required, Gunzinger said the current 500-nautical-mile limit of most affordable strike options undermines the CNAS report’s conclusion that more mass will equate to victory.

“China has the capability to project outer and inner rings of airborne and sea-based air defense sensors and shooters to defend its cross-Strait forces and operations,” Gunzinger said.

And using nonstealthy drones to approach the Chinese coastline to then launch affordable missiles doesn’t work either, he said. “This would likely result in losses of the aircraft and their weapons.”

“We win part of the battle,” Gunzinger said. “They win the war.”

Breaking a Stalemate

The numbers-on-numbers approach is what has led to a stalemate in the Russia-Ukraine War, said retired Navy Cmdr. J. Michael Dahm, now a senior fellow for aerospace and China studies at Mitchell.

“Just because you can generate mass doesn’t mean that you’re going to achieve your effects,” Dahm told Air & Space Forces Magazine. “You may be able to keep your adversary off balance, but if you’re not going to then judo throw him into what you want him to do, you’re just engaging in this kind of protracted, endless warfare.”

Throughout the history of the modern Chinese military, it has mostly been defense-oriented, Dahm said. The PLA has airfields dotting its landscape and hardened sites to pull and rotate forces from, as well as a layered air defense network.

What could overwhelm the Chinese defenses, however, is what the U.S. has seen poke through its defenses recently in the Middle East, Dahm said. Iranian air attacks have used a combination of low-end munitions and cheap drones with more expensive and capable missiles fired from various angles, locations, and at varying rates of speed to confuse and defeat air defenses.

This aligns with one of the report’s recommendations—for the Pentagon to develop new operational concepts that pair cheap and high-end weapons for mixed attacks.

“Using low-cost drones in the opening wave to identify air defenses, consume interceptors, and relay targeting data to follow-on missiles offers a promising and sustainable way to create repeated air base disruption,” according to the report. “High-end weapons should be preserved for more challenging targets, while affordable mass should be integrated into strike plans to service soft targets and to saturate air defenses.”

“The Iranians have figured out how to be effective: … send a whole bunch of slow-moving drones with a couple of cruise missiles and a couple of ballistic missiles,” Dahm said.

That’s because modern air defenders must set their systems to track certain ranges, altitudes, and speeds of whatever is in the airspace. And they can’t track everything effectively all at once.

“I don’t want a flock of birds showing up on my radar, so I set the speed gate for higher speed, but how high do I set it for? 100 knots or do I set it for Mach 3? What am I looking for? Range. How far am I looking? Altitude. Am I looking high? Am I looking low?” Dahm said.

Those factors mean an air defense system can’t stop everything.

“The way you overwhelm even the most sophisticated air defense system is you send some slow stuff, you send some medium stuff, and then you send these ballistic missiles that are screaming in from the upper atmosphere at Mach 3-4-5,” Dahm said. “It is hard for any modern air defense system to deal with all those inputs.”

While Iran is using that method against the U.S., Dahm advocates the U.S. use the same strategy in a Taiwan scenario against the PLA.

“That is absolutely what we should be doing,” Dahm said.

For example, to strike a Chinese military ship, such as a cruiser, Dahm said U.S. or coalition countries wouldn’t only send the same type of missile from one direction. They would simultaneously target the ship from air, land, sea, and subsurface platforms with a variety of projectiles at varying speeds and ranges, though the centerpiece of the assault might be an LRASM.

“You might send two LRASMs, but you need to accompany that with some of these more cost-effective missiles,” he said. “It is the reason we need the cost-effectiveness and the affordability, because we shouldn’t have an expectation that all of those weapons are going to work.”

新美国安全中心于9月18日发布的报告《无人机、导弹与美国弹药短缺：低成本规模在台湾冲突中的作用》主张增加远程武器，用于打击中国军事目标，以阻止中国大陆接管台湾。
这份由菲利普·希尔斯（Philip Sheers）和斯塔西·佩蒂约翰（Stacie Pettyjohn）撰写的报告指出，鉴于此类武器在与伊朗的冲突中持续使用，美国需要打击的目标数量与其不断减少的库存之间存在缺口。
希尔斯和佩蒂约翰写道：“在一场可能走向长期化的美中台湾冲突中，低成本系统所能提供的库存深度和破坏能力，对于扭转美国的劣势、阻止中国实现其作战目标，将具有无可估量的价值。”
为弥补这一缺口，报告建议既储备高端导弹，也大量集结廉价无人机和弹药，以压垮中国的进攻。其他建议包括：
- 提供多年期资金和合同，使制造商能够扩大武器生产能力，并使五角大楼能够重建远程导弹库存
- 为廉价远程反舰和对陆攻击武器提供资金，以迅速填补库存缺口
- 在各机型之间标准化共享部件，以降低成本并扩大生产规模。
将廉价无人机与先进导弹搭配使用，以消耗敌方防空力量。
优先采用易于制造的设计，而非过度追求工程复杂度。
就这些问题定期向国会通报最新情况并进行简报。
白宫和五角大楼今年已采取措施提高弹药产量，尤其是低成本武器。
7月，五角大楼宣布与 Anduril、CoAspire 和 Zone 5 Technologies 签署多年期框架协议，为美国空军大批量生产导弹；随后在9月17日宣布，洛克希德·马丁（Lockheed Martin）将扩大 AIM-260 联合先进战术导弹的生产。
前一项公告是美国空军“可负担批量导弹系列”（Family of Affordable Mass Missiles，FAMM）计划的一部分，该计划在2026财年预算中公布，目标是到2028年将此类导弹年产量提升至5,300枚，到2031年达到近8,000枚。
目前 FAMM 的五年预算预计超过120亿美元，用于采购近27,000枚导弹。
退役空军 Col. 马克·冈辛格（Mark Gunzinger）现任职于美国空军协会米切尔航空航天研究所，他对《空天军杂志》（Air & Space Forces Magazine）表示，新美国安全中心（CNAS）报告呼吁增加弹药是必要的，但他提醒说，该报告把重点放在让武器变得可负担上，这一点需要调整。
“问题不应在于购买更便宜的武器，而应在于如何优化战场空间中的单位效果成本，”冈辛格（Gunzinger）说。
冈辛格主张，空军必须以非对称方式作战，并最大化每次打击的效果，无论使用何种弹药或平台；在武器与平台的研发和采购方面存在一条中间道路。
诸如 Long-Range Anti-Ship Missile 等精确制导专用武器及其发射平台价格高昂，用于固定目标的低端短程弹药也有其用武之地，但冈辛格说，国防规划者如果过于注重价格而损害能力，往往会作出过度取舍。
“现在你得到了某种东西，‘好吧，你达到了某个价格点，但它能存活足够久以完成任务吗？’”冈辛格说。“它能在被击毁前发射自己的武器吗？”
数字游戏
CNAS报告的作战与战术重点，是通过打击解放军舰艇——驱逐舰和两栖攻击舰——以及打击中国外围靠近台湾海峡的机场，来反制解放军对台湾的攻击。
但它不包括打击中国大陆内陆的计划。
“该论文侧重于拒止解放军联合登岛作战，却没有考虑通过战略打击来剥夺解放军的庇护所并瓦解中国维持攻势的能力，”冈辛格说。“这有可能把与解放军围绕台湾的冲突简化为一场兵力对兵力的数学问题，比如需要多少武器和飞机来攻击位于台湾海峡和中国沿海的解放军部队。这有可能变成一场数字游戏。”
因为在台湾遭入侵的情景中可能需要打击中国大陆，冈辛格（Gunzinger）表示，大多数可负担打击选项目前500-nautical-mile的限制，削弱了CNAS报告关于更多规模将等同于胜利的结论。
冈辛格说：“中国有能力投送机载和海基防空传感器与射手的外环和内环，以防御其跨海峡部队和行动。”
他说，使用非隐身无人机接近中国海岸线，然后发射可负担的导弹，同样行不通。“这很可能导致飞机及其武器损失。”
“我们赢得战斗的一部分，”冈辛格说，“他们赢得战争。”
打破僵局
退役海军 Cmdr. J·迈克尔·达姆（J. Michael Dahm）——现为米切尔研究所航空航天与中国研究高级研究员——表示，以数量对数量的做法正是导致俄乌战争陷入僵局的原因。
达姆对《空军与太空部队杂志》表示：“仅仅因为你能集结规模，并不意味着你就能达成效果。”“你或许能让对手失去平衡，但如果你不能随后像柔道那样把他摔进你希望他做的事情中，那你只是在陷入这种旷日持久、无休无止的战争。”
达姆说，纵观现代中国军队的历史，它主要以防御为导向。解放军拥有遍布其国土的机场、可供部队撤出和轮换的加固阵地，以及分层防空网络。
达姆（Dahm）说，然而，可能压倒中国防御体系的，正是美国近期在中东所见到的能够突破美方防御的打法。伊朗空袭将低端弹药和廉价无人机，与从不同角度、不同地点、以不同速度发射的更昂贵、性能更强的导弹结合起来，以迷惑并击败防空系统。
这与报告的一项建议一致——即五角大楼应制定新的作战概念，将廉价武器与高端武器搭配用于混合攻击。
报告称：“在首波攻击中使用低成本无人机来识别防空系统、消耗拦截弹，并向后续导弹传递目标数据，提供了一种有前景且可持续的方式，可反复扰乱空军基地。”“高端武器应保留用于更具挑战性的目标，而可负担的大规模武器应纳入打击计划，以打击软目标并使防空系统饱和。”
达姆说：“伊朗人已经摸索出如何有效实施：……发射一大堆慢速无人机，再搭配几枚巡航导弹和几枚弹道导弹。”
这是因为现代防空人员必须将其系统设置为跟踪空域中任何目标的特定距离、高度和速度。而且他们无法同时有效跟踪所有目标。
达姆说：“我不想让一群鸟出现在我的雷达上，所以我把速度门限设得更高，但我该设到多少？100 knots还是Mach 3？我要找什么？距离。我看多远？高度。我是看高处？还是看低处？”
这些因素意味着防空系统不可能拦截一切。
达姆说：“要压倒即使最先进的防空系统，办法就是发射一些慢速目标，再发射一些中速目标，然后发射这些从高层大气以Mach 3-4-5呼啸而来的弹道导弹。”“任何现代防空系统都很难应对所有这些输入。”
在伊朗利用这种方法对付美国之际，达姆（Dahm）主张美国在台湾情景中采用同样策略对抗解放军。
“这绝对是我们应该做的，”达姆说。
例如，要打击一艘中国军舰，比如巡洋舰，达姆说，美国或联盟国家不会只从一个方向发射同一类型的导弹。它们会同时从空中、陆地、海上和水下平台，以速度与射程各异的多种弹药瞄准该舰，尽管此次攻击的核心可能是一枚 LRASM。
“你可能发射两枚 LRASM，但需要同时搭配一些更具成本效益的导弹，”他说。“这就是我们需要成本效益和可负担性的原因，因为我们不应指望所有这些武器都会奏效。”

例如，要打击一艘中国军舰，比如巡洋舰，达姆说，美国或联盟国家不会只从一个方向发射同一类型的导弹。它们会同时从空中、陆地、海上和水下平台，以速度与射程各异的多种弹药瞄准该舰，尽管此次攻击的核心可能是一枚 LRASM。

“你可能发射两枚 LRASM，但需要同时搭配一些更具成本效益的导弹，”他说。“这就是我们需要成本效益和可负担性的原因，因为我们不应指望所有这些武器都会奏效。”

items.title: US Navy destroyers tested in Middle East as demands mount
items.author: Natalie Oliverio
items.summary: The concentration of Navy destroyers in the Middle East raises questions about meeting sustained operational demand.
items.body:
Navy destroyers are concentrated in the Middle East as U.S. forces conduct operations against Iran, according to U.S. Central Command — a move that puts renewed operational demands on a fleet that has experienced prolonged maintenance periods.

As of Sept. 14, two Navy guided-missile destroyers were operating in the Red Sea and another 13 were in the Arabian Sea, according to the U.S. Naval Institute’s fleet tracker, which uses both Navy and public data.

The Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Stout also departed Naval Station Norfolk on Monday to begin deployment operations after months of training, maintenance and certification events, according to Naval Surface Force Atlantic.

The demand facing the class has been significant, even before the start of the Iran war.

The USS Carney spent 235 days deployed from September 2023 to May 2024 and conducted 51 engagements against Houthi-launched weapons, according to the Navy. The campaign demonstrated what operations around one of those chokepoints can demand from destroyers.

When USS Carney returned in May 2024, then-Chief of Naval Operations Adm. Lisa Franchetti told the crew that the last time the Navy had directly engaged an enemy to that degree was during World War II.

The renewed demand for destroyers in the Middle East comes as the Navy’s maintenance system has struggled to keep the fleet on schedule.

U.S. Fleet Forces Command declined to discuss its current destroyer readiness posture, current operations or potential effects on future deployment schedules, citing operational-security and classification guidelines. The command also declined to provide historical aggregate data on destroyer operational tempo.

According to a December 2025 Congressional Budget Office analysis of Navy maintenance data, the Arleigh Burke-class destroyer overhauls that began between 2011 and 2024 took an average of 26% longer than the Navy’s final schedules estimated.

The 225 DDG-51 overhauls CBO analyzed also required 8% more labor than scheduled.

CBO projected that DDG-51 destroyers will spend an average of more than nine years, or about 27% of their planned service lives, in maintenance. That is more than twice the roughly four years envisioned in the Navy’s 2012 class maintenance plans.

The federal budget agency identified several factors contributing to longer maintenance periods, including the aging fleet, postponed maintenance, late inspections and contract awards, unexpected additional work, delays in parts and materials and modernization work.

The average age of the DDG-51 fleet rose from 10 years in 2011 to 20 years in 2024.

The Government Accountability Office has found broader problems across the Navy’s conventional surface fleet.

In a January 2025 review, GAO found that the Navy requested nearly $24.9 billion for combat-surface-ship maintenance from fiscal 2020 through 2023 and reported that nearly $25.9 billion was appropriated. The Navy reported obligating 99.7% of that funding by the end of fiscal 2023. Yet, GAO found that the service continued to face shortages of spare parts, insufficient qualified maintenance personnel and a continuing need to defer maintenance.

CBO’s analysis covers maintenance events beginning in 2011 and points to longstanding factors, including the age of the destroyer fleet and postponed work.

Natalie Oliverio is an independent journalist and Navy veteran who covers military and veterans’ issues. Drawing on her experience as a talent executive and mentor, she writes about the policies, people and programs shaping the military community.
zhParas: 据美军中央司令部称，随着美军对伊朗开展行动，海军驱逐舰正集中部署在中东——此举给一支长期经历维护期的舰队带来了新的作战需求。
截至9月14日，根据美国海军学会（U.S. Naval Institute）的舰队追踪数据，两艘海军导弹驱逐舰正在红海行动，另有13艘在阿拉伯海；该追踪数据同时使用海军数据和公开数据。
据大西洋海军水面部队称，Arleigh Burke-class导弹驱逐舰USS Stout也于周一驶离诺福克海军基地，在历经数月训练、维护和认证活动后开始部署行动。
该级舰面临的需求一直十分巨大，甚至早在伊朗战争开始前就是如此。
据海军称，USS Carney从2023年9月至2024年5月期间部署了235天，并对胡塞武装发射的武器进行了51次交战。这场行动表明，在这些咽喉要道之一周边作战会对驱逐舰提出怎样的要求。
当USS Carney于2024年5月返回时，时任海军作战部长 Adm. 莉萨·弗兰凯蒂（Lisa Franchetti）告诉舰员，海军上一次如此程度地直接与敌人交战还是在第二次世界大战期间。
中东对驱逐舰的新需求出现之际，海军的维护体系一直难以让舰队按计划运行。
美国舰队部队司令部以行动安全和保密准则为由，拒绝讨论其当前驱逐舰战备态势、当前行动或对未来部署计划的潜在影响。该司令部还拒绝提供有关驱逐舰作战节奏的历史汇总数据。
根据美国国会预算办公室（CBO）2025年12月对海军维修数据的分析，2011年至2024年间启动的Arleigh Burke级驱逐舰大修，平均耗时比海军最终进度表估算的长26%。
CBO所分析的225次DDG-51大修，所需工时也比计划多8%。
CBO预测，DDG-51驱逐舰平均将在维修上花费九年以上，约占其计划服役寿命的27%。这比海军2012年舰级维修计划所设想的约四年多出一倍以上。
这家联邦预算机构指出，导致维修周期延长的因素有多个，包括舰队老化、维修推迟、检查与合同授予延迟、计划外的额外工作、零部件和材料延误以及现代化改装工作。
DDG-51舰队的平均舰龄从2011年的10年上升到2024年的20年。
美国政府问责局（GAO）发现，海军常规水面舰队存在范围更广的问题。
在2025年1月的一份审查报告中，GAO发现，海军在2020财年至2023财年为主战舰艇维修申请了近249亿美元，并报告称实际拨款近259亿美元。海军报告称，截至2023财年末已承付其中99.7%的资金。然而，GAO发现，该军种仍面临备件短缺、合格维修人员不足以及持续需要推迟维修的问题。
CBO的分析涵盖2011年开始的维修活动，并指向长期存在的因素，包括驱逐舰舰龄和推迟的工作。
娜塔莉·奥利韦里奥 (Natalie Oliverio) 是一名独立记者兼海军退伍军人，报道军事与退伍军人事务。她凭借作为人才高管和导师的经验，撰写有关塑造军人社区的政策、人物和项目的内容。

items.title: Investigators Blame F-16 Thunderbird Crash on Turned Fan Blade Deep in Engine
items.author: Greg Hadley
items.summary: A misaligned vane in an F-16 engine that field-level maintainers cannot see to inspect caused one of the U.S. Air Force's Thunderbird jets to crash last December, a new report concludes. The same problem led another F-16 to crash 20 months earlier. The post Investigators Blame F-16 Thunderbird Crash on Turned Fan Blade Deep in Engine appeared first on Air & Space Forces Magazine .
items.body:
A misaligned vane in an F-16 engine that field-level maintainers cannot see to inspect caused one of the U.S. Air Force’s Thunderbird jets to crash last December, a new report concludes. The same problem led another F-16 to crash 20 months earlier.

The pilots ejected in both cases, escaping with minor injuries, while both jets were total losses. Separate Air Force Accident Investigation Boards came to similar conclusions.

The report on the Dec. 3, 2025, Thunderbird crash in the California desert was released Sept. 21. The report on the prior crash, on April 30, 2024, near Holloman Air Force Base, N.M., was released months before the Thunderbird crash, in February 2025.

The latest investigation report valued the loss of the Thunderbird F-16 at $33.5 million.

Both accidents were blamed on turned variable vanes deep in the Pratt & Whitney F100-PW-220 engine’s high-pressure compressor. Investigators determined that one or more vanes were turned and misaligned, creating “abnormal aerodynamic forces” and “irregular wake patterns” as air flowed through the engines. The resulting stress on compressor blades caused vanes to break or crack, casuing the engines to “catastrophically” fail.

The Thunderbird investigation report cited three known instances where compressor blades fractured due to turned vanes, but it did not specify a third instance. Besides the Holloman crash in 2024 and the Thunderbird crash in 2025, no publicly released Accident Investigation Board reports from the last decade mention fractured compressor blades in the F100-PW-220.

In both the Holloman and Thunderbird cases, field maintainers failed to catch the misaligned vanes. While some stages can be inspected with a borescope, the fifth stage of the engine core cannot be seen in the F100-PW-220 without completely disassembling the engine core.

Notably, both F-16 engines in question had experienced foreign object debris, or FOD, events in the years prior to the crashes. The Thunderbird jet engine’s FOD event occurred in October 2021, and the Holloman F-16’s FOD event happened in August 2022. In both cases, maintainers noted damage to early stages of the inlet fan but found no issues with the fourth, seventh, or eighth stages, which they could inspect using a borescope.

The Air Force’s technical orders for the F-16 do not require maintainers to remove and disassemble the engine core to inspect those stages after a FOD event if no damage is found in the surrounding stages. It’s unclear if the FOD events caused the vanes to turn, however, so cannot be clearly blamed for triggering the events.

The accident investigation board for the Holloman F-16 crash noted that Pratt & Whitney’s analysis determined the FOD event was the probable cause of the vane turning, but expert opinions varied when asked if it was possible for damage to occur to a later stage if no damage was observed in the ones before it. That left the cause inconclusive.

Similarly, the board for the Thunderbird crash noted that it was “impossible to conclusively determine” what caused the turned vanes. It did, however, note that the lack of inspection for the fifth and sixth stages after a FOD event “substantially contributed to the mishap.”

“The post-FOD event guidance contains an inherent inability to inspect these specific sections of the engine core. Additionally, the core of the engine is only inspected during scheduled maintenance when a core component reaches its overhaul threshold, leaving time for potential damage to progress undetected,” the report states.

A spokesperson for the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center did not immediately comment on whether the technical guidance might be changed to require complete inspections following a FOD event or to trigger other steps to prevent similar mishaps. In February 2025, after the report for the Holloman crash was released, the spokesperson said the center’s F-16 program office “is looking at this issue and is working closely with the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center’s Propulsion Directorate, the engineering authority for the engine, to correct any deficiencies.”

‘Ejecting Was Ultimately the Only Option’

In addition to detailing the engine issues, the Thunderbird report detailed how the pilot did everything possible to save the jet.

An experienced instructor pilot with nearly 1,400 flight hours, the pilot was on a routine training flight working on loops and rolls and flying from the Thunderbirds’ famed “delta formation.” The mishap pilot had planned to peel off from the formation during the loops to avoid exacerbating a stiff neck, then rejoin the formation for the rolls. But as the pilot waited to rejoin, the engine stalled. It felt “like the jet just … stopped midair,” the pilot told investigators.

Seeking to recover, the pilot sacrificed speed to gain altitude, then tried a secondary engine control. When that didn’t work, the pilot attempted an engine restart. “It sounded like things were grinding,” the pilot reported later. Finally, more than four minutes after the engine stalled, the pilot chose to eject.

The Accident Investigation Board concluded that “ejecting was ultimately the only option which provided a favorable outcome.”

Yet the ejection wasn’t flawless—the F-16’s ACES II ejection seat has two hoses that transfer hot gas from the ejection initiators to the sequence valves, and they’re supposed to disconnect automatically during an ejection. One of the hoses in the Thunderbird F-16 didn’t disconnect properly but ripped from the violence of the ejection.

The plane went down near Trone, Calif., a small desert community near Death Valley. Upon impact, debris scattered up to 750 feet away. A local civilian who saw the crash got to the pilot first, and Navy search and rescue responded within minutes to transport for medical care. The pilot was discharged the same day.
zhParas: 一份新报告得出结论，F-16发动机内一个外场维修人员无法看到并进行检查的错位导流叶片，导致美国空军“雷鸟”飞行表演队的一架战机去年12月坠毁。同样的问题导致另一架F-16在20个月前坠毁。
两起事故中飞行员均弹射逃生，仅受轻伤，而两架战机均完全报废。空军分别成立的事故调查委员会得出了类似结论。
关于2025年12月3日“雷鸟”战机在加利福尼亚沙漠坠毁的报告于9月21日发布。关于此前2024年4月30日在新墨西哥州霍洛曼空军基地附近坠毁的那起事故的报告，于2025年2月发布，比“雷鸟”坠机早了数月。
最新调查报告将“雷鸟”F-16的损失估值为3350万美元。
两起事故都被归咎于普惠 F100-PW-220 发动机高压压气机深处的可调导流叶片发生偏转。调查人员认定，一个或多个导流叶片发生偏转且错位，在空气流经发动机时产生“异常气动力”和“不规则尾流形态”。由此在压气机叶片上产生的应力导致导流叶片断裂或开裂，进而使发动机“灾难性”失效。
“雷鸟”事故调查报告列举了三起已知的因导流叶片偏转导致压气机叶片断裂的事件，但未具体说明第三起事件。除2024年霍洛曼坠机事故和2025年“雷鸟”坠机事故外，过去十年公开发布的事故调查委员会报告中，没有其他报告提到 F100-PW-220 的压气机叶片断裂。
在霍洛曼和“雷鸟”两起事故中，外场维修人员都未能发现错位的导流叶片。虽然部分级可用内窥镜检查，但在 F100-PW-220 上，若不彻底分解发动机核心，就无法看到核心第五级。
值得注意的是，涉事的两台F-16发动机在坠机前几年都曾发生过外来物碎片（FOD）事件。“雷鸟”战机发动机的FOD事件发生在2021年10月，霍洛曼F-16的FOD事件发生在2022年8月。两起事件中，维修人员都注意到进气道风扇前几级的损伤，但未发现第四、第七或第八级存在问题，而这些级他们可以用内窥镜检查。
美国空军针对 F-16 的技术规程不要求维护人员在 FOD 事件后、若相邻级未发现损伤时拆卸并分解发动机核心机来检查这些级。但目前尚不清楚 FOD 事件是否导致叶片转动，因此不能明确将其归咎为引发这些事件的原因。
霍洛曼（Holloman）F-16 坠机事故调查委员会指出，普拉特·惠特尼（Pratt & Whitney）的分析认定 FOD 事件是叶片转动的可能原因，但当被问及如果在前面的级未观察到损伤，后面的级是否可能发生损伤时，专家意见不一。这使得原因无法定论。
同样，雷鸟（Thunderbird）坠机事故调查委员会指出，“无法最终确定”是什么导致叶片转动。但它确实指出，FOD 事件后未对第五和第六级进行检查“对事故有重大促成作用”。
“FOD 事件后的指导文件本身就无法检查发动机核心机的这些特定部位。此外，发动机核心机仅在计划维护期间、当某个核心机部件达到翻修阈值时才接受检查，这使潜在损伤得以在未被发现的情况下发展，”报告称。
空军寿命周期管理中心的一名发言人未立即就技术指南是否可能被修改，以要求在 FOD 事件后进行完整检查，或启动其他步骤以防止类似事故置评。2025 年 2 月，霍洛曼坠机事故报告发布后，该发言人说，该中心的 F-16 项目办公室“正在研究这一问题，并正与空军寿命周期管理中心的推进局——该发动机的工程主管机构——密切合作，以纠正任何缺陷。”
“弹射最终是唯一选择”
除了详述发动机问题外，雷鸟事故报告还详述了飞行员如何竭尽全力挽救战机。
这名飞行员是一名经验丰富的飞行教官，拥有近 1,400 飞行小时，当时正在执行例行训练飞行，练习筋斗和横滚，并在雷鸟队著名的“三角队形”中飞行。涉事飞行员原计划在筋斗动作期间脱离编队，以免加重颈部僵硬，随后再重新加入编队进行横滚。但就在飞行员等待重新加入时，发动机失速。飞行员告诉调查人员，感觉“就像战机突然……停在了半空中”。
为设法恢复飞机状态，飞行员牺牲速度以换取高度，随后尝试了备用发动机控制。未能奏效后，飞行员又尝试重启发动机。“听起来像有东西在研磨，”飞行员后来报告说。最终，在发动机失速四分钟多后，飞行员选择弹射。
事故调查委员会得出结论：“弹射最终是唯一能带来有利结果的选择。”
然而，这次弹射并非完美无缺——F-16 的 ACES II 弹射座椅有两根软管，用于将高温燃气从弹射启动器输送到顺序阀，按设计它们应在弹射过程中自动断开。雷鸟飞行表演队那架 F-16 上的一根软管没有正常断开，而是因弹射的巨大冲击力被扯断。
飞机在加利福尼亚州 Trone 附近坠毁，那是死亡谷附近的一个沙漠小社区。撞击时，碎片散落到最远 750 feet 外。一名目睹坠机的当地平民最先到达飞行员身边，海军搜救人员几分钟内响应并后送其接受医疗救治。飞行员当天出院。

一份新报告得出结论，F-16发动机内一个外场维修人员无法看到并进行检查的错位导流叶片，导致美国空军“雷鸟”飞行表演队的一架战机去年12月坠毁。同样的问题导致另一架F-16在20个月前坠毁。

两起事故中飞行员均弹射逃生，仅受轻伤，而两架战机均完全报废。空军分别成立的事故调查委员会得出了类似结论。

关于2025年12月3日“雷鸟”战机在加利福尼亚沙漠坠毁的报告于9月21日发布。关于此前2024年4月30日在新墨西哥州霍洛曼空军基地附近坠毁的那起事故的报告，于2025年2月发布，比“雷鸟”坠机早了数月。

最新调查报告将“雷鸟”F-16的损失估值为3350万美元。

两起事故都被归咎于普惠 F100-PW-220 发动机高压压气机深处的可调导流叶片发生偏转。调查人员认定，一个或多个导流叶片发生偏转且错位，在空气流经发动机时产生“异常气动力”和“不规则尾流形态”。由此在压气机叶片上产生的应力导致导流叶片断裂或开裂，进而使发动机“灾难性”失效。

“雷鸟”事故调查报告列举了三起已知的因导流叶片偏转导致压气机叶片断裂的事件，但未具体说明第三起事件。除2024年霍洛曼坠机事故和2025年“雷鸟”坠机事故外，过去十年公开发布的事故调查委员会报告中，没有其他报告提到 F100-PW-220 的压气机叶片断裂。

在霍洛曼和“雷鸟”两起事故中，外场维修人员都未能发现错位的导流叶片。虽然部分级可用内窥镜检查，但在 F100-PW-220 上，若不彻底分解发动机核心，就无法看到核心第五级。

值得注意的是，涉事的两台F-16发动机在坠机前几年都曾发生过外来物碎片（FOD）事件。“雷鸟”战机发动机的FOD事件发生在2021年10月，霍洛曼F-16的FOD事件发生在2022年8月。两起事件中，维修人员都注意到进气道风扇前几级的损伤，但未发现第四、第七或第八级存在问题，而这些级他们可以用内窥镜检查。

美国空军针对 F-16 的技术规程不要求维护人员在 FOD 事件后、若相邻级未发现损伤时拆卸并分解发动机核心机来检查这些级。但目前尚不清楚 FOD 事件是否导致叶片转动，因此不能明确将其归咎为引发这些事件的原因。

霍洛曼（Holloman）F-16 坠机事故调查委员会指出，普拉特·惠特尼（Pratt & Whitney）的分析认定 FOD 事件是叶片转动的可能原因，但当被问及如果在前面的级未观察到损伤，后面的级是否可能发生损伤时，专家意见不一。这使得原因无法定论。

同样，雷鸟（Thunderbird）坠机事故调查委员会指出，“无法最终确定”是什么导致叶片转动。但它确实指出，FOD 事件后未对第五和第六级进行检查“对事故有重大促成作用”。

“FOD 事件后的指导文件本身就无法检查发动机核心机的这些特定部位。此外，发动机核心机仅在计划维护期间、当某个核心机部件达到翻修阈值时才接受检查，这使潜在损伤得以在未被发现的情况下发展，”报告称。

空军寿命周期管理中心的一名发言人未立即就技术指南是否可能被修改，以要求在 FOD 事件后进行完整检查，或启动其他步骤以防止类似事故置评。2025 年 2 月，霍洛曼坠机事故报告发布后，该发言人说，该中心的 F-16 项目办公室“正在研究这一问题，并正与空军寿命周期管理中心的推进局——该发动机的工程主管机构——密切合作，以纠正任何缺陷。”

“弹射最终是唯一选择”

除了详述发动机问题外，雷鸟事故报告还详述了飞行员如何竭尽全力挽救战机。

这名飞行员是一名经验丰富的飞行教官，拥有近 1,400 飞行小时，当时正在执行例行训练飞行，练习筋斗和横滚，并在雷鸟队著名的“三角队形”中飞行。涉事飞行员原计划在筋斗动作期间脱离编队，以免加重颈部僵硬，随后再重新加入编队进行横滚。但就在飞行员等待重新加入时，发动机失速。飞行员告诉调查人员，感觉“就像战机突然……停在了半空中”。

为设法恢复飞机状态，飞行员牺牲速度以换取高度，随后尝试了备用发动机控制。未能奏效后，飞行员又尝试重启发动机。“听起来像有东西在研磨，”飞行员后来报告说。最终，在发动机失速四分钟多后，飞行员选择弹射。

事故调查委员会得出结论：“弹射最终是唯一能带来有利结果的选择。”

然而，这次弹射并非完美无缺——F-16 的 ACES II 弹射座椅有两根软管，用于将高温燃气从弹射启动器输送到顺序阀，按设计它们应在弹射过程中自动断开。雷鸟飞行表演队那架 F-16 上的一根软管没有正常断开，而是因弹射的巨大冲击力被扯断。

items.title: Space Force Seeks Maneuverable Spacecraft for On-Demand Launch
items.author: Courtney Albon
items.summary: The Space Force may invest in a maneuverable space vehicle that can be available for an on-demand launch in response to “emerging threats,” according to a new industry notice. The post Space Force Seeks Maneuverable Spacecraft for On-Demand Launch appeared first on Air & Space Forces Magazine .
items.body:
The Space Force may invest in a maneuverable space vehicle that can be available for an on-demand launch in response to “emerging threats,” according to a new industry notice.

In a Sept. 18 request for information, Space Systems Command’s Space Safari program office—which leads the service’s Tactically Responsive Space program—said they’re interested in buying a commercial spacecraft that can perform what are known as rendezvous proximity operations and dock to other satellites. The notice specifies a potential need for the capability as soon as fiscal 2029.

“[The] Space Safari program rapidly acquires, integrates, and deployed space systems to address urgent combatant commander needs and emerging threats outside traditional programs of record,” the notice states. “To achieve this, the office seeks innovative, cost-efficient solutions for unpredictable mission requirements.”

The notice doesn’t spell out how many of these vehicles the Space Force might buy but identifies a target “tasking-to-launch” timeline of 14 days. It also stresses the need for modular systems that can integrate a variety of payloads should the service need to swap a system at the last minute.

The Space Force defines Tactically Responsive Space, or TacRS, as the ability to quickly respond to on-orbit threats in any number of ways—from launching a rocket on demand to maneuvering an at-the-ready satellite to replace or augment another to buying commercial space capabilities during a conflict.

Space Safari has been demonstrating and progressing new TacRS capabilities over the last few years. In 2023, Firefly’s Alpha rocket launched a Millennium Space Systems payload just 27 hours after receiving launch orders as part of the service’s Victus Nox mission. Then in late 2025 and early 2026, it conducted a tabletop effort and field exercise called Victus Diem aimed at refining its processes for repeatable rapid launch.

In June, the service launched Victus Haze, which focused on validating multiple TacRS concepts, including dynamic space operations between two satellites. In this case, a Rocket Lab satellite launched on demand and a True Anomaly spacecraft prepositioned on orbit took turns playing the role of adversary and conducting “dynamic engagements” including pursuits between the two satellites.

Those demonstrations have put the service on a path toward operationalizing TacRS concepts. The Space Force’s fiscal 2027 budget request, which includes $86 million for TacRS demonstrations, says Space Safari plans to use funding to support “operational missions requiring both rapid launch and maneuverable, prepositioned capabilities.”

The documents also note that the Space Force plans to establish a “rapid reaction force structure” that would involve having satellites in production and on hand, ready for rapid launch as needed. The Sept. 18 notice appears to be an early step in that direction.

In a briefing at AFA’s Air, Space & Cyber conference, acting portfolio acquisition executive for space combat power Col. Bryon McClain told reporters the service is in the process of transitioning TacRS into an “operational system.” He noted that while the Space Force has additional missions planned, it would likely be saying “less and less” about them.

“You’re probably going to hear a lot less about that overall because we see this as an important warfighting capability, and the last thing you want to do is make that too public,” he said Sept. 16.

For now, the five known TacRS missions expected to launch in the next few years are:

- Victus Surgo, a mission cosponsored by the Defense Innovation Unit that will feature a SpaceX Falcon 9 launching a highly maneuverable spacecraft built by Impulse Space

- Victus Salo 1, set to launch in 2027 on a Falcon 9 rocket that will carry a payload built by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology

- Victus Salo 2 and 3, which don’t yet have a public timeline but will involve Impulse Space’s pre-positioned Mira orbital maneuver vehicle

- Victus Sol, launched by Firefly’s Alpha, which will carry an operational payload
zhParas: 根据一份新的业界通知，太空军可能投资一种可机动航天器，以便能够按需发射，应对“新兴威胁”。
在9月18日的一份信息征询书中，太空系统司令部的 Space Safari 项目办公室——该办公室牵头太空军的战术响应太空项目——表示，他们有意购买一种商业航天器，能够执行所谓的交会接近操作，并与其他卫星对接。通知明确，该能力可能最早在2029财年就需要具备。
“Space Safari 项目快速采办、整合并部署太空系统，以满足作战司令部司令的紧急需求，并应对传统正式项目之外的新兴威胁，”通知称。“为实现这一目标，该办公室正在为不可预测的任务需求寻求创新且成本高效的解决方案。”
通知未说明太空军可能购买多少这类飞行器，但提出了14天的“从受领任务到发射”目标时限。通知还强调，需要模块化系统，能够整合多种有效载荷，以便在太空军需要在最后一刻更换系统时使用。
太空军将战术响应太空（TacRS）定义为以多种方式快速应对在轨威胁的能力——从按需发射火箭，到机动一颗待命卫星以替换或增强另一颗卫星，再到在冲突期间购买商业太空能力。
过去几年，Space Safari 一直在演示并推进新的 TacRS 能力。2023年，作为太空军 Victus Nox 任务的一部分，Firefly 的 Alpha 火箭在收到发射指令后仅27小时就发射了 Millennium Space Systems 的有效载荷。随后在2025年底和2026年初，它开展了名为 Victus Diem 的桌面推演和实地演习，旨在完善其可重复快速发射流程。
6月，该军种发射了 Victus Haze 任务，重点验证多项 TacRS 概念，包括两颗卫星之间的动态太空操作。在此次任务中，一颗按需发射的 Rocket Lab 卫星和一颗预先部署在轨的 True Anomaly 航天器轮流扮演对手，并实施“动态交战”，包括两颗卫星之间的追逐。
这些演示使该军种走上了将 TacRS 概念投入实际运用的道路。太空军2027财年预算申请包括为 TacRS 演示编列8600万美元，其中称 Space Safari 计划利用这些资金支持“既需要快速发射，又需要可机动、预先部署能力的作战任务”。
文件还指出，太空军计划建立一种“快速反应力量结构”，即让卫星处于生产状态并随时可用，以便在需要时快速发射。9月18日的通知似乎是朝这一方向迈出的早期一步。
在AFA航空、太空与网络大会的一场简报会上，负责太空作战力量的代理组合采办执行官 Col. 拜伦·麦克莱恩（Bryon McClain）告诉记者，该军种正在将 TacRS 转变为一种“作战系统”。他指出，尽管太空军还计划了更多任务，但很可能会对它们“越来越少”地谈及。
“总的来说，你们对此听到的消息很可能会少得多，因为我们认为这是一种重要的作战能力，而最不应该做的就是将其过度公开。”他在9月16日表示。
目前，已知将在未来几年发射的五项 TacRS 任务是：
- Victus Surgo，一项由国防创新单元共同支持的任务，将使用 SpaceX Falcon 9 发射由 Impulse Space 制造的高机动性航天器
- Victus Salo 1，计划于2027年由 Falcon 9 火箭发射，该火箭将搭载由麻省理工学院（Massachusetts Institute of Technology）研制的有效载荷
- Victus Salo 2 和 3，尚未公布时间表，但将使用 Impulse Space 预先部署的 Mira 轨道机动飞行器
- Victus Sol，由 Firefly 公司的 Alpha 火箭发射，将搭载作战有效载荷

items.title: DM Airmen participate in Coyote Storm 26.2 to reinforce AEW 2.0 concepts
items.author: Capt. M. Anna Turpin
items.summary: The multi-day training event operationalized Air Expeditionary Wing 2.0 concepts across cross-functional disciplines, including field medicine, combat search and rescue, and command and control.
items.body:
Published Sept. 22, 2026

By Capt. M. Anna Turpin

355th Wing Public Affairs

Airmen from the 355th Wing strengthened their ability to operate in contested environments during Coyote Storm 26.2 at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base , Sept. 14-17. Coyote Storm 26.2 was a training exercise focused on improving flexibility and readiness through the Air Expeditionary Wing 2.0 concept. AEW 2.0 training requires that preparation for deployments happens long before members go into theater and ensures that they have the time to train together across disciplines.

items.title: Royal Navy successfully launches US Mk 48 torpedo from uncrewed submersible
items.author: Claire Barrett
items.summary: Last week, the Royal Navy successfully launched a U.S.-made Mk 48 Heavyweight Torpedo from a British Excalibur uncrewed underwater vehicle.
items.body:
The Royal Navy successfully launched a U.S. Navy Mk 48 Heavyweight Torpedo from a British Excalibur uncrewed underwater vehicle, or UUV, marking a significant step toward allied operational fleets of uncrewed vehicles.

The successful Sept. 13 launch at the British Underwater Test & Evaluation Centre in Scotland highlights a major operational achievement for AUKUS Pillar 2 — a multilateral agreement between the U.S., U.K. and Australia to enable Uncrewed Undersea Vehicle payload systems that can be used across each country’s UUVs, according to the May 2026 agreement.

While still just a proof of concept, the successful test, according to the Navy press release, “validated the mechanical, electrical, and software integration of a U.S. kinetic payload onto an allied autonomous vessel, proving that allied forces can rapidly achieve weapon interchangeability.”

The allied cooperation and testing marks “a historic first for allied undersea warfare,” said Adm. Daryl Caudle, Chief of Naval Operations. “Proving that we can seamlessly launch a U.S. heavyweight torpedo from a Royal Navy autonomous underwater vehicle validates our shared vision for true interchangeability. By integrating weapons, payloads, and mission architectures across allied platforms, we are increasing the flexibility, scale, and combat power of our combined forces and ensuring they are ready to meet the strategic demands of tomorrow.”

The latest version of the Mk 48, the MOD 7, a result of a Joint Development Program with the Royal Australian Navy, is optimized for both “traditional and emerging missions, according to the Navy, while the Excalibur, unveiled in May 2025, is the Royal Navy’s first uncrewed submarine.

From video of the event, it appears that the Mk 48 torpedo was placed under the nearly 40-foot British submersible and launched from a cradle attached to the hull of the UUV.

The Mk 48 torpedo, the U.S. Navy’s standard heavyweight torpedo, stands at 19 feet long with a 21-inch diameter.

According to the U.K.’s Navy Lookout, “Excalibur has no torpedo tubes, but a large central payload bay with doors at the top and bottom. However, the Mk 48 torpedo… is too long to fit in the standard central payload bay.”

With close coordination between the two navies, it is conceivable that future UUVs will deploy sophisticated weapon launch arrangements suitable for both British and American-made technologies.

The successful deployment of the heavyweight torpedo is just the first step under AUKUS Pillar 2.

This proof of concept is just the first step, however, as the U.S. and Royal Navy continue an aggressive “follow-on acceleration with Project CUTLASS” that will utilize the Anduril Dive-XL platform and tackle “advanced payload integration data, command and control architectures, and tactical employment scenarios to further mature uncrewed undersea capabilities,” per the release.

Claire Barrett is an editor and military history correspondent for Military Times. She holds a master's degree in military history from King's College, London, and is also a World War II researcher with an unparalleled affinity for Sir Winston Churchill and Michigan football.
zhParas: 英国皇家海军成功从英国 Excalibur 无人水下航行器（UUV）上发射了一枚美国海军 Mk 48 重型鱼雷，标志着向盟国无人航行器作战舰队迈出了重要一步。
根据 2026 年 5 月的协议，此次 9 月 13 日在苏格兰英国水下测试与评估中心成功完成的发射，凸显了奥库斯联盟第二支柱的一项重大作战成果——该支柱是美国、英国和澳大利亚之间的一项多边协议，旨在促成可通用于各国 UUV 的无人水下航行器载荷系统。
尽管仍只是概念验证，但根据海军新闻稿，此次成功试验“验证了将美国动能载荷集成到盟国自主航行器上的机械、电气和软件集成，证明盟军能够快速实现武器互换性”。
海军作战部长 Adm. 达里尔·考德尔（Daryl Caudle）表示，此次盟国合作与试验标志着“盟国水下作战的历史性首次”。“证明我们能够从皇家海军自主水下航行器上无缝发射美国重型鱼雷，验证了我们对真正互换性的共同愿景。通过在各盟国平台上整合武器、载荷和任务架构，我们正在提升联合部队的灵活性、规模和战斗力，并确保它们准备好应对未来的战略需求。”
Mk 48 的最新型号 MOD 7 是与澳大利亚皇家海军联合开发计划的成果，据海军称，其针对“传统任务和新兴任务”进行了优化；而 2025 年 5 月亮相的 Excalibur 则是皇家海军首艘无人潜艇。
从事件视频来看，Mk 48 鱼雷似乎被置于近 40-foot 的英国潜航器下方，并从连接在 UUV 艇体上的托架发射。
Mk 48 鱼雷是美国海军的标准重型鱼雷，长 19 feet，直径 21-inch。
据英国的 Navy Lookout 报道，“Excalibur 没有鱼雷发射管，而是有一个大型中央载荷舱，顶部和底部均设有舱门。然而，Mk 48 鱼雷……太长，无法装入标准的中央载荷舱。”
在两支海军密切协调下，可以想象，未来的无人潜航器（UUV）将部署精密的武器发射配置，以适配英国和美国制造的技术。
重型鱼雷的成功部署只是奥库斯联盟第二支柱下的第一步。
然而，这一概念验证只是第一步，因为美国海军和英国皇家海军继续推进一项积极的“CUTLASS 项目后续加速”工作，该工作将利用 Anduril 的 Dive-XL 平台，并攻克“先进有效载荷集成数据、指挥控制架构和战术运用场景，以进一步推动无人水下能力成熟”，据新闻稿称。
克莱尔·巴雷特（Claire Barrett）是《军事时报》的编辑兼军事历史记者。她拥有伦敦国王学院军事史硕士学位，还是一名二战研究者，对温斯顿·丘吉尔爵士（Sir Winston Churchill）和密歇根大学橄榄球有着无与伦比的热爱。

items.title: Italian Navy plots race of two local machines: an F-35B against a Ferrari
items.author: Tom Kington
items.summary: The Italian Navy wants to find out if one of its F-35B fighter jets can outrace a Ferrari SF90 on the ground.
items.body:
ROME — The F-35B fighter can take off on a very short runway, hover in the air and land vertically, but the Italian navy is about to find out whether it can also outrace a Ferrari.

In an unusual race planned next month at the Navy’s air base at Grottaglie in southern Italy, one of its F-35Bs will go head-to-head with a Ferrari SF90 to see which has the punchier acceleration.

“We are used to getting a result, but this will be tough,” said Fabio Barone, who will be behind the wheel of the SF90 after claiming seven speed records in a Ferrari.

A Navy spokesman confirmed the race would go ahead.

The first race on Oct. 11 will be over 500 meters on an aluminum runway used by the F-35Bs at Grottaglie for landing. At the end of the course the F-35B will take off.

Barone said the car will normally accelerate from zero to 100 km/h in 2.8 seconds, but with special engine tuning it will do it in 2.6 seconds.

That will allow the car to reach 330 km/h over the 500 meters and complete the course in 8-9 seconds.

“With that acceleration, I will face 2.2g, meaning 140kg of pressure,” he said.

“The F35B will make a slower start but has more power,” he added.

A second race, on asphalt and aluminium, will be run over 2.8 km. After 500 meters the F-35B will take over and complete the race in flight at

an altitude of about 20 metres.

Barone, 54, said the car and the aircraft will race together on one 35 meter wide runway, meaning there will be just 15 meters between them.

“We will be very close,” he said. “The challenge will be driving over the aluminium plates, which will create vibration,” he added.

Asked why exactly he was keen to race against a jet fighter, Barone said, “Everyone can race against another car, and this is a chance to put on a show. Additionally, Michael Schumacher did it,” he said.

In 2003, the former Formula One driver drove a Ferrari Formula One car in races with an Italian Air Force Eurofighter at Italy’s Grosseto air base - an event which drew a crowd of 50,000.

The Eurofighter won 900- and 1,200–meter races without taking off. Schumacher however won a 600-meter race, accelerating from the starting line to reach 294 km/h and complete the course in 9.6 seconds, beating the Eurofighter by two-tenths of a second.

Barone previously worked with the Italian Navy when he drove a Ferrari last year along the flight deck of the Navy’s new Trieste carrier vessel, reaching 164 km/h over about 200 meters before slamming on the brakes to avoid flying off the end of the ship.

Tom Kington is the Italy correspondent for Defense News.
zhParas: 罗马——F-35B 战斗机能够在极短的跑道上起飞、在空中悬停并垂直降落，但意大利海军即将弄清楚它是否也能跑赢法拉利。
下个月，在意大利南部格罗塔列的意大利海军航空基地，计划举行一场不同寻常的比赛：意海军一架 F-35B 将与一辆法拉利 SF90 正面较量，看谁的加速更猛。
“我们习惯于拿到结果，但这次会很艰难，”法比奥·巴罗内（Fabio Barone）说。他将驾驶这辆 SF90，此前他已驾驶法拉利创下七项速度纪录。
一名海军发言人证实，比赛将如期举行。
10 月 11 日的首场比赛将在格罗塔列供 F-35B 降落使用的铝制跑道上进行，赛程 500 米。到达终点后，F-35B 将起飞升空。
巴罗内说，这辆车通常从静止加速到 100 km/h 需要 2.8 秒，但经过特殊的发动机调校后，只需 2.6 秒。
这将使该车在 500 米赛程内达到 330 km/h，并在 8 至 9 秒内跑完全程。
“在这样的加速度下，我将承受 2.2g，也就是 140 公斤的压力，”他说。
“F35B 起步会更慢，但动力更强，”他补充道。
第二场比赛在沥青和铝板上进行，赛程为 2.8 km。500 meters 后，F-35B 将接管比赛，并在飞行中完成赛程，飞行高度为
约 20 metres。
巴罗内（Barone）54 岁，他说赛车和飞机将在一条 35 meter 宽的跑道上同场竞速，这意味着两者之间只有 15 meters 的距离。
“我们将非常接近，”他说。“挑战在于驶过铝板，那会产生振动，”他补充道。
当被问及究竟为何热衷于与喷气式战斗机竞速时，巴罗内（Barone）说：“谁都可以和另一辆汽车竞速，而这是一个表演的机会。此外，迈克尔·舒马赫（Michael Schumacher）就这么做过，”他说。
2003 年，这位前一级方程式赛车手在意大利格罗塞托（Grosseto）空军基地驾驶一辆法拉利一级方程式赛车，与意大利空军的 Eurofighter 进行比赛——这场活动吸引了 50,000 名观众。
Eurofighter 未起飞便赢得了 900 meter 和 1,200 meter 的比赛。然而，舒马赫（Schumacher）赢得了一场 600 meter 的比赛，从起跑线加速至 294 km/h，并以 9.6 seconds 完成赛程，以 0.2 second 的优势击败了 Eurofighter。
巴罗内（Barone）此前曾与意大利海军合作：去年，他驾驶一辆法拉利沿意大利海军新型“的里雅斯特”号航母的飞行甲板行驶，在约 200 meters 的距离内达到 164 km/h，随后猛踩刹车，以免从舰船末端冲出。
汤姆·金顿（Tom Kington）是《防务新闻》驻意大利记者。

items.title: CENTCOM has become a battle lab for unmanned systems
items.author: Natalie Oliverio
items.summary: Unmanned systems have moved quickly from experimentation and exercises into the demands of an active war.
items.body:
When a U.S. Army helicopter went down near the Strait of Hormuz in June, an unmanned U.S. Navy vessel went looking for the crew.

The Corsair, operated by U.S. 5th Fleet’s Task Force 59, helped recover two U.S. service members. A month later, three Corsairs were used for something entirely different: striking a submarine and ship maintenance facility at the Bandar Abbas naval base in Iran, marking the “first time American forces have employed sea drones in combat operations,” CENTCOM confirmed.

The two missions illustrate how quickly unmanned systems have moved from experimentation and exercises into the demands of an active war.

A U.S. official told Military Times that American forces are now using unmanned systems “on, above, and below [the sea],” in support of military objectives and said they have been effective, particularly in reducing risk to U.S. forces personnel.

Joshua Tallis, director of Ally and Partner Security Affairs at the Center for Naval Analyses, or CNA, said real-world use of uncrewed systems gives the Navy an “unrivaled opportunity” to learn how to command and deploy robotic systems and refine their deployment, employment and sustainment.

Deployment of unmanned systems

The Navy began Task Force 59 in 2021 to accelerate the integration of unmanned systems and artificial intelligence into operations across the Middle East. The task force used unmanned platforms to expand maritime awareness and work alongside crewed ships and aircraft.

In a 2022 exercise, unmanned vessels identified training targets and relayed information to command centers ashore, while the Navy said the additional sensors could help position crewed ships to respond more rapidly.

By 2024, the service had established Task Group 59.1 to focus on the operational deployment of unmanned systems teamed with manned operators. Task Force 59 personnel participated in more than 30 exercises and operations under its previous commander, according to the Navy.

The Navy’s February 2026 Fighting Instructions lay out specific roles for unmanned platforms. Chief of Naval Operations Adm. Daryl Caudle described medium unmanned surface vessels as designed for “scouting, screening, and striking,” while identifying unmanned underwater vehicles for water-space denial, survey and mine warfare. The 2026 guidance also calls for attritable, easily replenishable unmanned surface vessels as part of the fleet’s force design.

That Navy effort is now unfolding alongside a separate CENTCOM push to put unmanned systems directly into combat.

CENTCOM has already begun building a combat-focused unmanned force. In December 2025, the command established Task Force Scorpion Strike as the military’s first dedicated one-way attack drone squadron in the Middle East.

The task force employed low-cost one-way attack drones during Operation Epic Fury. At the same time, CENTCOM used unmanned attack vessels during the July strikes on Iranian port facilities, according to the command.

In August, CENTCOM announced plans for Task Force Falcon Strike, a multinational, multidomain attack-drone task force that will use one-way attack drones from above, on and below the sea. CENTCOM said Falcon Strike would expand attack-drone capabilities across the Middle East with regional partners.

The Fighting Instructions also envision unmanned and manned units operating with varying degrees of independence. Caudle said the Navy will use “Delegated Autonomy Levels” to define “what a unit manned or unmanned can do independently,” based in part on its ability to sense the battlespace, synthesize what matters and deliver effects without waiting for higher headquarters.

Combat puts additional demands on unmanned systems, including maintaining communications, operating for extended periods, navigating contested waters and remaining useful when an adversary is actively trying to interfere with them.

The systems are no longer being judged only in an exercise environment. They are being judged in real time by what happens when an adversary is working to stop them.

Despite the opportunities provided by deploying uncrewed systems in the current conflict, Tallis cautioned against drawing broad conclusions from it. The public examples from the war, he said, should be viewed as “an iterative learning moment, not a fully formed vision of the future fight.”

Cost is one unresolved issue. Open-source estimates put a Corsair at about $1.1 million, Tallis said. That raises a broader question about what it means for an unmanned system to be considered “attritable,” “consumable” or “expendable.”

The war has also exposed the risks that come with putting unmanned systems into contested waters.

In September, Iran said it had captured an Anduril Dive-LD autonomous underwater vehicle that had malfunctioned while surveying regional waters. CENTCOM said the vehicle was an older model that did not collect sensitive data or carry classified sonar or radar equipment.

More recently, CENTCOM said two Iranian boats attempted to take possession of a U.S. Saildrone unmanned surface vessel operating in the Strait of Hormuz. U.S. forces destroyed the boats, according to the command.

According to Tallis, there is an unanswered question of how much risk the military should accept when deploying uncrewed systems, including how to determine when a system has delivered enough value to justify its loss. Many unmanned systems are cheaper than crewed platforms, he said, but “not, per se, cheap.”

Tallis said unmanned systems remain particularly well suited to surveillance, consistent with their use by the U.S. over the past two decades. But there is not yet enough evidence to demonstrate a meaningful change in the use of unmanned surface vessels for strike.

Search-and-rescue missions could also require platforms to be positioned across a theater to provide quick reaction times, something Tallis said does not yet appear to be widely fielded.

Natalie Oliverio is an independent journalist and Navy veteran who covers military and veterans’ issues. Drawing on her experience as a talent executive and mentor, she writes about the policies, people and programs shaping the military community.
zhParas: 当一架美国陆军直升机6月在霍尔木兹海峡附近坠毁时，一艘美国海军无人舰艇前去搜寻机组人员。
美国第五舰队第59特遣队操作的Corsair无人艇协助寻回了两名美国军人。一个月后，三艘Corsair无人艇被用于一项完全不同的任务：打击伊朗阿巴斯港海军基地的一处潜艇和舰船维修设施，这标志着“美军首次在作战行动中使用海上无人艇”，美军中央司令部证实。
这两次任务表明，无人系统从试验和演习转入一场正在进行的战争需求之中的速度有多快。
一名美国官员告诉《军事时报》，美军目前正在“海面、海面上空和水下”使用无人系统，以支持军事目标，并称这些系统行之有效，尤其是在降低美军人员风险方面。
美国海军分析中心（Center for Naval Analyses，简称CNA）盟友与伙伴安全事务主任乔舒亚·塔利斯（Joshua Tallis）表示，无人系统在现实世界中的使用为海军提供了一个“无与伦比的机会”，使其学习如何指挥和部署机器人系统，并改进其部署、运用和保障方式。
无人系统的部署
海军于2021年启动第59特遣队，以加快将无人系统和人工智能整合到整个中东地区的行动中。该特遣队使用无人平台扩大海上态势感知，并与有人舰艇和飞机协同行动。
在2022年的一次演习中，无人舰艇识别了训练目标，并将信息传回岸上指挥中心，同时海军表示，这些额外传感器可帮助有人舰艇就位，以便更迅速地作出反应。
到2024年，海军已成立第59.1特遣群，重点负责与有人操作员协同的无人系统的作战部署。据海军称，第59特遣部队人员在其前任指挥官领导下参加了30多次演习和行动。
海军2026年2月的《战斗指令》明确了无人平台的具体任务。海军作战部长 Adm. 达里尔·考德尔（Daryl Caudle）将中型无人水面舰艇描述为设计用于“侦察、掩护和打击”，同时指出无人水下航行器用于水域拒止、勘测和水雷战。2026年指南还要求将可消耗、易于补充的无人水面舰艇纳入舰队兵力设计。
海军的这一努力目前正在与美军中央司令部另一项将无人系统直接投入作战的推进同步展开。
美军中央司令部已开始组建一支以作战为重点的无人部队。2025年12月，该司令部成立了“蝎子打击”特遣部队，作为美军在中东的首支专用单向攻击无人机中队。
该特遣部队在“史诗之怒”行动中使用了低成本单向攻击无人机。据该司令部称，与此同时，美军中央司令部在7月对伊朗港口设施的打击中使用了无人攻击艇。
8月，美军中央司令部宣布了“猎鹰打击”特遣部队的计划，这是一支多国、多域攻击无人机特遣部队，将使用来自空中、水面和水下的单向攻击无人机。美军中央司令部表示，“猎鹰打击”将与地区伙伴一道，在中东各地扩展攻击无人机能力。
《战斗指令》还设想有人和无人部队以不同程度的独立性行动。考德尔表示，海军将使用“授权自主等级”来界定“有人或无人部队可独立完成哪些任务”，部分依据是其感知战场、整合关键信息并在无需等待上级司令部的情况下产生效果的能力。
作战对无人系统提出了额外要求，包括保持通信、长时间运行、在争议水域航行，以及在对手正积极试图干扰它们时仍能发挥作用。
这些系统不再仅仅在演习环境中受到评判。当对手设法阻止它们时，实际发生的情况正在实时评判它们。
尽管在当前冲突中部署无人系统带来了机遇，塔利斯（Tallis）仍告诫不要从中得出广泛结论。他说，这场战争中的公开案例应被视为“一个迭代学习时刻，而非对未来作战的完整构想”。
成本是一个尚未解决的问题。塔利斯表示，开源评估显示，一套 Corsair 的价格约为110万美元。这引发了一个更广泛的问题：一套无人系统被视为“可损耗”“可消耗”或“可牺牲”究竟意味着什么。
这场战争也暴露了将无人系统投入争议水域所带来的风险。
9月，伊朗表示已捕获一架在区域水域进行测量时发生故障的 Anduril Dive-LD 自主水下航行器。美军中央司令部表示，该航行器是较旧型号，未收集敏感数据，也未搭载机密声呐或雷达设备。
最近，美军中央司令部表示，两艘伊朗船只试图夺取一艘正在霍尔木兹海峡作业的美国 Saildrone 无人水面艇。据该司令部称，美军摧毁了这两艘船。
据塔利斯称，一个尚未解答的问题是，军方在部署无人系统时应承受多大风险，包括如何确定一套系统何时已产生足够价值，从而证明其损失是合理的。他说，许多无人系统比有人平台便宜，但“本身并不便宜”。
塔利斯表示，无人系统仍特别适合监视，这与美国过去二十年对它们的使用情况一致。但尚无足够证据表明，无人水面艇在打击用途上发生了实质性变化。
搜救任务也可能要求在整个战区部署平台，以确保能够快速反应；塔利斯 (Tallis) 表示，这种能力似乎尚未广泛列装。
娜塔莉·奥利韦里奥 (Natalie Oliverio) 是一名独立记者兼海军退伍军人，报道军事与退伍军人议题。凭借其作为人才主管和导师的经验，她撰写有关影响军人社区的政策、人物和项目的文章。

items.title: F-16 fighter jet crashes at US air base in western Germany
items.author: Reuters
items.summary: An F-16 fighter jet assigned to the US air base Spangdahlem in western Germany crashed on Tuesday, according to U.S. officials.
items.body:
An F-16 fighter jet assigned to the US air base Spangdahlem in western Germany crashed on Tuesday, the U.S. military said, adding that one pilot had ejected safely and was receiving medical treatment.

The cause of the incident is under investigation, the military said in a statement, with emergency response personnel at the scene of the crash.

Germany’s air traffic control authority, in a separate statement, said a total of four F-16s had been taking part in a training exercise.

“Two were still in the training area, while two were returning to Spangdahlem Air Base. One of these two jets is believed to have crashed while on approach,” it said, adding the remaining F-16s had landed at the US Air Force base in Ramstein.
zhParas: 美军表示，一架隶属于德国西部施潘达勒姆（Spangdahlem）美国空军基地的F-16战斗机于周二坠毁，并称一名飞行员已安全弹射逃生，正在接受医疗救治。
军方在一份声明中表示，事故原因正在调查之中，应急救援人员已抵达坠机现场。
德国空中交通管制部门在另一份声明中表示，共有四架F-16参加了此次训练演习。
该部门称：“其中两架仍在训练空域，另外两架则在返回施潘达勒姆空军基地的途中。据信，这两架战机中有一架是在进近过程中坠毁的。”并补充说，其余F-16已降落在拉姆施泰因（Ramstein）美国空军基地。

items.title: F-16 Crashes in Germany; Pilot Successfully Ejects
items.author: Chris Gordon
items.summary: A U.S. Air Force F-16 Fighting Falcon crashed on a local mission in Germany on Sept. 22. The pilot ejected safely and is receiving medical care, Air Force officials said. The fighter was assigned to the 52nd Fighter Wing at Spangdahlem Air Base. The jet went down on base property in the Eifel region of western Germany. The post F-16 Crashes in Germany; Pilot Successfully Ejects appeared first on Air & Space Forces Magazine .
items.body:
A U.S. Air Force F-16 Fighting Falcon crashed on a local mission in Germany on Sept. 22.

The pilot ejected safely and received medical care, Air Force officials said. The fighter was assigned to the 52nd Fighter Wing at Spangdahlem Air Base.

In a statement, the wing said the jet was returning to base after a four-ship “routine training flight” when it crashed on approach to Spangdahlem’s sole runway around 2:30 p.m. local time. The incident occurred on base property near the runway. The three other F-16s diverted to Ramstein Air Base, Germany, and landed safely.

The day after the crash, the 52nd Fighter Wing said the pilot suffered “minor injuries” and was treated and released from a local hospital.

The cause of the crash is under investigation “in accordance with established U.S. Air Force mishap investigation procedures and Air Force Safety Center requirements,” the wing added in a statement. Air Force emergency personnel and local German rescue crews responded to the incident.

This is the second F-16 crash for the Air Force in five days—a Viper belonging to the Texas Air National Guard’s 149th Fighter Wing crashed during a training mission in Michigan on Sept. 17. The pilot in that crash ejected safely as well.

The 52nd Fighter Wing has one squadron of F-16s that specializes in the “Wild Weasel” mission of suppressing enemy air defenses. The U.S. military deployed fighters from the unit to the Middle East twice during the seven-month conflict with Iran. Forward deployments typically consist of a dozen fighter jets, and Spangdahlem has over two dozen F-16s that comprise the 52nd Fighter Wing’s sole fighter squadron, the 480th Fighter Squadron. The 480th is permanently based at Spangdahlem as part of U.S. Air Forces in Europe.

Images posted to social media and captured by local press show a charred hunk of the F-16, including what appears to be its engine, amid a wide debris field. Black smoke billowed over the base as emergency personnel responded to the scene.

This article was updated Sept. 23 with additional information.
zhParas: 9月22日，一架美国空军F-16 Fighting Falcon在德国执行当地任务时坠毁。
空军官员表示，飞行员安全弹射并接受了医疗救治。这架战斗机隶属于施潘达勒姆空军基地的第52战斗机联队。
该联队在一份声明中表示，这架战机在完成四机编队“例行训练飞行”后返回基地，当地时间下午2时30分左右在进近施潘达勒姆唯一跑道时坠毁。事发地点位于基地内靠近跑道的位置。另外三架F-16改道飞往德国拉姆施泰因空军基地并安全降落。
坠机次日，第52战斗机联队表示，飞行员受了“轻伤”，在当地医院接受治疗后出院。
该联队在一份声明中补充说，坠机原因正在“按照美国空军既定的事故调查程序和空军安全中心的要求”进行调查。美国空军应急人员和德国当地救援人员对事件作出了响应。
这是美国空军五天内发生的第二起F-16坠机事件——9月17日，得克萨斯州空军国民警卫队第149战斗机联队的一架Viper在密歇根州执行训练任务时坠毁。那起坠机中的飞行员也安全弹射。
第52战斗机联队拥有一个F-16中队，专门执行压制敌方防空系统的“野鼬鼠”（Wild Weasel）任务。美国军方在与伊朗为期七个月的冲突期间，两次将该部队的战斗机部署到中东。前沿部署通常由12架战斗机组成，而施潘达勒姆拥有二十多架F-16，构成第52战斗机联队唯一的战斗机中队——第480战斗机中队。第480中队作为美国驻欧空军的一部分，永久驻扎在施潘达勒姆。
发布到社交媒体并由当地媒体拍摄的图片显示，在大片残骸散落区域中，有一块烧焦的F-16残骸，其中包括疑似其发动机的部件。应急人员赶赴现场处置时，基地上空黑烟滚滚。
本文于9月23日更新，补充了更多信息。

空军官员表示，飞行员安全弹射并接受了医疗救治。这架战斗机隶属于施潘达勒姆空军基地的第52战斗机联队。

该联队在一份声明中表示，这架战机在完成四机编队“例行训练飞行”后返回基地，当地时间下午2时30分左右在进近施潘达勒姆唯一跑道时坠毁。事发地点位于基地内靠近跑道的位置。另外三架F-16改道飞往德国拉姆施泰因空军基地并安全降落。

坠机次日，第52战斗机联队表示，飞行员受了“轻伤”，在当地医院接受治疗后出院。

该联队在一份声明中补充说，坠机原因正在“按照美国空军既定的事故调查程序和空军安全中心的要求”进行调查。美国空军应急人员和德国当地救援人员对事件作出了响应。

这是美国空军五天内发生的第二起F-16坠机事件——9月17日，得克萨斯州空军国民警卫队第149战斗机联队的一架Viper在密歇根州执行训练任务时坠毁。那起坠机中的飞行员也安全弹射。

第52战斗机联队拥有一个F-16中队，专门执行压制敌方防空系统的“野鼬鼠”（Wild Weasel）任务。美国军方在与伊朗为期七个月的冲突期间，两次将该部队的战斗机部署到中东。前沿部署通常由12架战斗机组成，而施潘达勒姆拥有二十多架F-16，构成第52战斗机联队唯一的战斗机中队——第480战斗机中队。第480中队作为美国驻欧空军的一部分，永久驻扎在施潘达勒姆。

发布到社交媒体并由当地媒体拍摄的图片显示，在大片残骸散落区域中，有一块烧焦的F-16残骸，其中包括疑似其发动机的部件。应急人员赶赴现场处置时，基地上空黑烟滚滚。

本文于9月23日更新，补充了更多信息。

items.body:
DAYTON, Ohio (AFLCMC) -- “You are part of the fight,” Lt. Gen. Jason Voorheis, commander of the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center (AFLCMC) told attendees at the Ohio Defense and Aerospace Forum earlier this week. “ General Dale White [Director, Critical Major Weapon Systems at the Pentagon] is fond of saying that militaries don't go to war - nations go to war. You all are part of what our nation brings to the fight in terms of developing fielding and getting capability into the hands of our warfighters.”

Voorheis spoke as part of a panel titled “Power Projection from the Heartland.” He was joined on stage by Brig. Gen. Timothy Helfrich, AFLCMC Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) for Fighters and Advanced Aircraft, alongside defense industry professionals TK Kubit and Anthony Cain. JP Nauseef of JobsOhio moderated the discussion. The forum was hosted by the Dayton Development Coalition.

Held at Wright State University on September 21, 2026, the forum highlighted the strategic alignment between Air Force modernization priorities and the Ohio defense ecosystem.

Acquisition Speed and Agility

The Ohio Defense Ecosystem

Workforce and Talent Development

In his opening remarks, Voorheis explained the Air Force acquisition workforce's shift to accept risk earlier, lean into commercial technology and open mission systems, and empower program teams to make decisions that drive projects forward.

Both Voorheis and Helfrich noted that acquisition teams at Wright-Patt and across the Center are transitioning away from platform-specific "stovepipes" to focus on broader, integrated capabilities across advanced aircraft. These teams are also balancing intensive current fleet modernization with future systems development by shifting from individual platform upgrades to an integrated, "system of systems" approach.

“I think one of the really important parts about the acquisition transformation is the change in philosophy and focus on delivering fielded capability as kind of the preeminent prioritized pacing thing that we do, and everything else is about how we achieve that to include the authorities we're giving PAEs,” noted Voorheis.

Helfrich’s Fighters and Advanced Aircraft portfolio includes the A-10, F-15, F-16, F-22, plus the FQ-42, FQ-44, other collaborative combat aircraft.

The Air Force Research Lab (AFRL) is also headquartered at Wright-Patt. Helfrich touted how AFRL led key advances in open architecture and credits AFRL with developing the Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) program.

“There would be no CCA without the Air Force Research Laboratory,” explained Helfrich. “Both the FQ-42 Vengeance [and] the FQ-44 Fury were heavily invested in by AFRL. Because software is sold separately with CCA, the mission autonomy work started at AFRL. They were really the ones who put together the first consortium to build Autonomous Government Reference Architecture (A-GRA). This has become a huge program, all made possible because of the investments by AFRL.”

For both Voorheis and Helfrich, the workforce and supporting infrastructure remain top concerns. Helfrich urged educators in the audience to modernize military engineering and software development classes. Both speakers noted the shortage of physical defense infrastructure in the area around Wright-Patterson, particularly for high-level classified work.

In addition to physical plant limitations, hiring remains a challenge. AFLCMC currently has over 1,700 vacancies , with more than half located at Wright-Patt. Most open positions are in technical fields like engineering and logistics. Business areas like contracting and program management also have many openings.

“We need help recruiting from the universities and from industry as well, both defense industry and non-defense industry,” explained Voorheis. “You don't have to come in with a lot of aerospace experience. What we really need is highly talented, motivated, critical thinkers.”

The panel marked the first time Lt. Gen. Voorheis has publicly spoken about his role leading AFLCMC since assuming command late last month .
zhParas: 代顿，俄亥俄州（AFLCMC）——“你们是战斗的一部分，”美国空军生命周期管理中心（AFLCMC）司令 Lt. Gen. 贾森·沃里斯（Jason Voorheis）本周早些时候在俄亥俄国防与航空航天论坛上对与会者说。“戴尔·怀特将军（Dale White）[五角大楼关键重大武器系统主管]喜欢说，军队不会开战——国家才会开战。你们所有人都是我国为这场战斗所贡献力量的一部分，无论是开发、列装，还是把能力交到我们的作战人员手中。”

沃里斯作为题为“来自腹地的力量投射”的专题讨论小组成员发言。与他同台的有 Brig. Gen. 蒂莫西·赫尔弗里希（Timothy Helfrich），AFLCMC 战斗机与先进飞机组合采办执行官（PAE），以及国防工业专业人士 TK·库比特（TK Kubit）和安东尼·凯恩（Anthony Cain）。JobsOhio 的 JP·诺西夫（JP Nauseef）主持了讨论。该论坛由代顿发展联盟主办。
论坛于2026年9月21日在莱特州立大学举行，凸显了空军现代化优先事项与俄亥俄国防生态系统之间的战略协同。
采办速度与敏捷性
俄亥俄国防生态系统
劳动力与人才发展
沃里斯在开场致辞中解释说，空军采办队伍正在转变，更早接受风险，积极采用商业技术和开放任务系统，并赋予项目团队作出推动项目前进的决策的权力。
沃里斯和赫尔弗里希都指出，Wright-Patt 以及整个中心的采办团队正从针对特定平台的“烟囱式”模式转向，专注于先进飞机更广泛的一体化能力。这些团队还在平衡当前密集的机队现代化与未来系统开发，从单个平台升级转向一体化的“系统之系统”方法。
“我认为采办转型真正重要的部分之一，是理念的转变，以及把交付已列装能力作为我们最重要的优先事项和节奏牵引，而其他一切——包括我们赋予PAE的权限——都是为了实现这一目标，”沃海斯（Voorheis）指出。
赫尔弗里希（Helfrich）的“战斗机与先进飞机”组合包括A-10、F-15、F-16、F-22，以及FQ-42、FQ-44和其他协同作战飞机。
美国空军研究实验室（AFRL）也总部设在赖特-帕特森（Wright-Patt）。赫尔弗里希盛赞AFRL在开放架构方面引领了关键进展，并将协同作战飞机（CCA）项目的发展归功于AFRL。
“没有美国空军研究实验室，就不会有CCA，”赫尔弗里希解释道。“AFRL对FQ-42‘复仇’和FQ-44‘狂怒’都投入了大量资金。由于CCA的软件是单独销售的，任务自主性工作始于AFRL。他们确实是组建首个联盟来构建自主政府参考架构（A-GRA）的一方。这已成为一个庞大的项目，而这一切都得益于AFRL的投资。”
对沃海斯和赫尔弗里希而言，劳动力和配套基础设施仍是首要关切。赫尔弗里希敦促在场教育工作者对军事工程和软件开发课程进行现代化改革。两位发言人都指出，赖特-帕特森周边地区缺乏实体国防基础设施，尤其是用于高级别机密工作的设施。
除实体设施限制外，招聘仍是一项挑战。美国空军生命周期管理中心（AFLCMC）目前有超过1,700个职位空缺，其中一半以上位于赖特-帕特森。大多数空缺职位属于工程和后勤等技术领域。合同签订和项目管理等业务领域也有许多空缺。
“我们需要在从大学以及产业界招聘方面获得帮助，既包括国防产业，也包括非国防产业，”沃海斯解释道。“你不需要带着丰富的航空航天经验入职。我们真正需要的是才华出众、积极进取、善于批判性思考的人。”
此次小组讨论标志着Lt. Gen.沃海斯自上月底就任指挥官以来，首次公开谈及他领导AFLCMC的职责。

items.title: South Korea faces no good choices in sending forces for Trump’s unpopular Iran mission
items.author: Leilani Chavez
items.summary: Experts worry that U.S. requests for troop contributions to America's faraway campaigns could leave South Korea exposed when it matters most.
items.body:
MANILA, Philippines — As Washington presses South Korea to contribute to securing the Strait of Hormuz, experts said Seoul is facing a military capacity dilemma, as forces could get stretched amid escalating threats from North Korea.

The worry comes as Washington exerts pressure on South Korea to support U.S. operations in the Strait of Hormuz, where the war with Iran is choking worldwide oil supplies, even while North Korean threats escalate.

The South Korean Army reported that the North had fired two ballistic missiles on Sunday and earlier this month launched a 5,000-ton guided missile destroyer in the Pacific.

The security environment in East Asia raises a military allocation concern, especially since South Korean officials mentioned sending a “practical contribution” to U.S. efforts in the Middle East.

“If such [U.S.] requests become recurrent, Seoul could face trade-offs between extra-regional missions and deterrence around the Korean Peninsula,” Ju Hyung Kim, president of Security Management Institute, a Seoul-based defense think tank, told Defense News.

Last week, President Lee Jae Myeong had drawn the line and said there would be “no deployment to a war.”

The government may instead extend the activities of the Cheonghae Unit, a naval task force group stationed in the Sea of Aden for counter-piracy operations.

The Cheonghae Unit is a small maritime task group that includes a KDX-II destroyer, a maritime helicopter, as well as Marines, naval special forces and support personnel.

The Cheonghae may be the “least burdensome option,” Kim said, and would allow the Lee government to skirt the domestic political costs of a troop deployment and provide a military contribution.

While the range of operations could extend from Somalia to the Middle East, an expert based in Seoul told Defense News on condition of anonymity that the unit’s role will be limited to protecting South Korean ships and conducting humanitarian assistance activities.

“I don’t see the possibility of upgrade or recalibration … given the current security situation in the region,” the expert said.

Either way, the Cheonghae detachment would be navigating rough waters. Esmaeil Baqaei, spokesperson for Iran’s Foreign Ministry, warned on Sept. 7 that any foreign military involvement in the strait could face serious consequences.

Iranian academic Mohammad Marandi said that Tehran could regard South Korea as an enemy and target Korean economic and military assets across the Persian Gulf if Seoul joined a U.S.-led effort to secure the Strait of Hormuz.

The warnings had escalated anxieties in Seoul, where the deployment question remains a point of contention.

If South Korean personnel or assets are targeted, Lee would be pressured to either “escalate by deploying combat forces or to scale back to contain domestic backlash and protect his political standing,” Kim said.

“Seoul would need to define the mission, geographical scope, rules of engagement and command arrangements very carefully, while also managing external expectations about what a ‘practical contribution’ actually entails,” Kim said.

The government had begun to assess contribution requirements, which experts said are evident in an earlier recon mission to the United Arab Emirates to examine the Al Dhafra Air Base and Jebel Ali Port.

Findings from the trip have not been made public. But a successive mission to Bahrain, which hosts the U.S. Fifth Fleet, U.S. Naval Forces Central Command and the multinational Combined Maritime Forces, “could involve examining basing, logistics, intelligence-sharing, maritime-domain awareness and coordination with multinational forces,” Kim said.

The Cheonghae Unit may be enough to appease Washington for now, especially after Seoul committed a $20 billion investment in an energy project in Texas, Kim said.

But the larger challenge is the precedent it might create: President Donald Trump might expect additional contributions as the conflict in the Middle East continues.

And Kim said force allocation will become a graver concern if alliance commitments take South Korean assets far from the peninsula for a prolonged period of time.

“A P-8A deployed to the Gulf, for example, cannot simultaneously perform maritime-surveillance or anti- submarine missions around the Korean Peninsula,” he said.

“So the key question is not simply whether the Cheonghae Unit is sufficient now, but whether it becomes the beginning of recurring U.S. expectations for South Korean deployments beyond Northeast Asia,” Kim said.

Leilani Chavez is an Asia correspondent for Defense News. Her reporting expertise is in East Asian politics, development projects, environmental issues and security.
zhParas: 菲律宾马尼拉——随着华盛顿施压韩国为保障霍尔木兹海峡安全作出贡献，专家表示，首尔正面临军事能力困境，因为在朝鲜威胁不断升级之际，其兵力可能捉襟见肘。
这一担忧出现之际，华盛顿正施压韩国支持美国在霍尔木兹海峡的行动；在那里，与伊朗的战争正导致全球石油供应受阻，而与此同时朝鲜威胁也在升级。
韩国陆军报告称，朝鲜周日发射了两枚弹道导弹，并于本月早些时候在太平洋下水了一艘5,000-ton导弹驱逐舰。
东亚的安全环境引发了军事资源分配方面的担忧，尤其是因为韩国官员提到要向美国在中东的行动提供“实际贡献”。
“如果此类[美国]请求变得频繁，首尔可能面临域外任务与朝鲜半岛周边威慑之间的取舍，”首尔防务智库安全管理研究所所长金周亨（Ju Hyung Kim）对《防务新闻》表示。
上周，总统李在明（Lee Jae Myeong）已经划下红线，并表示“不会向战争部署兵力”。
政府可能改为延长清海部队（Cheonghae Unit）的活动期限，这是一支驻扎在亚丁湾执行反海盗行动的海军特遣部队。
清海部队是一支小型海上特遣群，包括一艘KDX-II驱逐舰、一架海上直升机，以及海军陆战队、海军特种部队和支援人员。
金（Kim）说，清海部队（Cheonghae）可能是“负担最小的选项”，可让李（Lee）政府规避派兵所付出的国内政治代价，并作出军事贡献。
尽管行动范围可能从索马里延伸至中东，但一名驻首尔专家以匿名条件对《防务新闻》表示，该部队的作用将仅限于保护韩国船只和开展人道主义援助活动。
“鉴于该地区当前的安全形势，我看不出有升级或重新调整的可能性……”这名专家说。
无论如何，清海分遣队都将在险恶水域中航行。伊朗外交部发言人伊斯梅尔·巴加埃（Esmaeil Baqaei）9月7日警告称，任何外国军事力量介入该海峡都可能面临严重后果。
伊朗学者穆罕默德·马兰迪（Mohammad Marandi）表示，如果首尔加入美国主导的确保霍尔木兹海峡安全的行动，德黑兰可能将韩国视为敌国，并把波斯湾各地的韩国经济和军事资产作为目标。
这些警告加剧了首尔的焦虑，而派兵问题在当地仍是一个争议焦点。
金（Kim）说，如果韩国人员或资产成为目标，李将面临压力，要么“通过部署作战部队使局势升级，要么缩减行动以遏制国内反弹并保护自己的政治地位”。
金（Kim）说：“首尔需要非常谨慎地界定任务、地理范围、交战规则和指挥安排，同时还要管理外界对‘实际贡献’究竟意味着什么的预期。”
政府已开始评估贡献需求，专家称，这一点从此前派往阿拉伯联合酋长国、考察阿尔达夫拉空军基地和杰贝阿里港的侦察任务中已可见端倪。
此行结果尚未公开。但随后前往巴林的任务——美国第五舰队、美国海军中央司令部和多国联合海上力量的驻地——“可能涉及考察基地设置、后勤、情报共享、海域态势感知以及与多国部队的协调，”金（Kim）说。

金表示，如果联盟承诺使韩国的资产长期远离朝鲜半岛，那么兵力分配将成为一个更加严峻的问题。

菲律宾马尼拉——随着华盛顿施压韩国为保障霍尔木兹海峡安全作出贡献，专家表示，首尔正面临军事能力困境，因为在朝鲜威胁不断升级之际，其兵力可能捉襟见肘。

这一担忧出现之际，华盛顿正施压韩国支持美国在霍尔木兹海峡的行动；在那里，与伊朗的战争正导致全球石油供应受阻，而与此同时朝鲜威胁也在升级。

韩国陆军报告称，朝鲜周日发射了两枚弹道导弹，并于本月早些时候在太平洋下水了一艘5,000-ton导弹驱逐舰。

东亚的安全环境引发了军事资源分配方面的担忧，尤其是因为韩国官员提到要向美国在中东的行动提供“实际贡献”。

“如果此类[美国]请求变得频繁，首尔可能面临域外任务与朝鲜半岛周边威慑之间的取舍，”首尔防务智库安全管理研究所所长金周亨（Ju Hyung Kim）对《防务新闻》表示。

上周，总统李在明（Lee Jae Myeong）已经划下红线，并表示“不会向战争部署兵力”。

政府可能改为延长清海部队（Cheonghae Unit）的活动期限，这是一支驻扎在亚丁湾执行反海盗行动的海军特遣部队。

清海部队是一支小型海上特遣群，包括一艘KDX-II驱逐舰、一架海上直升机，以及海军陆战队、海军特种部队和支援人员。

尽管行动范围可能从索马里延伸至中东，但一名驻首尔专家以匿名条件对《防务新闻》表示，该部队的作用将仅限于保护韩国船只和开展人道主义援助活动。

“鉴于该地区当前的安全形势，我看不出有升级或重新调整的可能性……”这名专家说。

无论如何，清海分遣队都将在险恶水域中航行。伊朗外交部发言人伊斯梅尔·巴加埃（Esmaeil Baqaei）9月7日警告称，任何外国军事力量介入该海峡都可能面临严重后果。

这些警告加剧了首尔的焦虑，而派兵问题在当地仍是一个争议焦点。
