items.title: US Army awards Lockheed Martin $1.2B PrSM contract
items.author: Michael Peck
items.summary: The U.S. Army awarded Lockheed Martin a PrSM contract worth up to $1.2 billion.
items.body:
The U.S. Army awarded Lockheed Martin a $1.2 billion contract for its short-range ballistic missiles.

The indefinite-delivery, indefinite-quantity contract covers initial production and future orders of Increment 2 of the Precision Strike Missile, or PrSM, according to a Lockheed Martin announcement.

“This award marks an important step in delivering PrSM Increment 2 to the warfighter,” Dave Griser, Lockheed Martin vice president for precision fires, said in the announcement. “We’re ready to move from flight testing into production and provide the Army with an expanded long-range precision fires capability.”

PrSM is intended to replace the Army Tactical Missile System, first fielded in the early 1990s. It has a range of about 500 kilometers, versus about 300 kilometers for the ATACMS. PrSM can be launched from the M142 High Mobility Artillery Rocket System and the M270 Multiple Launch Rocket System.

PrSM Increment 2 features a multimode seeker that can lock on to moving targets on land. It can also hit ships moving at sea, giving land-based launchers a maritime strike capability.

Lockheed Martin is currently conducting flight testing of the new PrSM version.

“PrSM Increment 2 completed its first flight test in March and its second flight test in August — obtaining critical data during flight, launching from a HIMARS, deploying protective covers and engaging the target,” the manufacturer said.

More PrSM Increment 2 flight tests are scheduled for 2027.

PrSM recently made its controversial combat debut in the Iran war. Analysts believe a PrSM missile, which sprays a cloud of pellets, killed dozens of civilians in the Iranian city of Lamerd on Feb. 28, the first day of U.S.-Israeli strikes against Iran. U.S. Central Command has denied the accusation.

The U.S. military faces a desperate shortage of strike and air defense missiles after expending vast numbers in Iran. This reportedly includes a lack of PrSM weapons.

The new contract builds on the Department of Defense’s broader investment in ballistic missiles, according to Lockheed Martin.

“Lockheed Martin is expanding capacity to quadruple PrSM production while continuing to develop additional PrSM increments,” the company said.

Michael Peck is a correspondent for Defense News and a columnist for the Center for European Policy Analysis. He holds an M.A. in political science from Rutgers University. Find him at theuncommondefense.com. His email is mikedefense1@gmail.com.
zhParas: 美国陆军授予洛克希德·马丁公司一份价值12亿美元的合同，用于其近程弹道导弹。
洛克希德·马丁公司发布消息称，这份不定期交付、不定量合同涵盖精确打击导弹（PrSM）增量2的初始生产和未来订单。
洛克希德·马丁公司精确火力副总裁戴夫·格里泽（Dave Griser）在公告中表示：“这一合同授予标志着向作战人员交付PrSM增量2迈出重要一步。”“我们已准备好从飞行测试转入生产，并为美国陆军提供扩展后的远程精确火力能力。”
PrSM旨在取代20世纪90年代初首次列装的陆军战术导弹系统（ATACMS）。其射程约为500公里，而ATACMS约为300公里。PrSM可从M142高机动性火箭炮系统和M270多管火箭发射系统发射。
PrSM增量2配备多模导引头，可锁定陆上移动目标。它还能打击海上移动舰船，使陆基发射装置具备海上打击能力。
洛克希德·马丁公司目前正在对新型PrSM进行飞行测试。
制造商表示：“PrSM增量2于3月完成首次飞行测试，并于8月完成第二次飞行测试——在飞行中获取关键数据、从HIMARS发射、展开防护罩并打击目标。”
更多PrSM增量2飞行测试计划于2027年进行。
PrSM 近日在伊朗战争中完成了其颇具争议的实战首秀。分析人士认为，2 月 28 日——即美国与以色列对伊朗发动打击的第一天——一枚可喷射弹丸云的 PrSM 导弹在伊朗城市拉梅尔德（Lamerd）造成数十名平民死亡。美军中央司令部否认了这一指控。
美军在伊朗消耗了大量导弹后，打击导弹与防空导弹严重短缺。据报道，这其中也包括 PrSM 武器的不足。
洛克希德·马丁公司（Lockheed Martin）称，这份新合同建立在国防部对弹道导弹更广泛投资的基础之上。
该公司表示：“洛克希德·马丁公司正在扩大产能，以将 PrSM 产量提升至四倍，同时继续研发更多 PrSM 改进批次。”
迈克尔·佩克（Michael Peck）是《防务新闻》（Defense News）的记者，也是欧洲政策分析中心的专栏作家。他拥有罗格斯大学政治学硕士学位。可在 theuncommondefense.com 找到他。他的电子邮箱是 mikedefense1@gmail.com。

items.title: Netanyahu May Have Ignored a Dire Warning. Israel Ignores the Deeper Threat.
items.summary: Israel's strategy in Gaza is only keeping Hamas in power: deterred, but not replaced, with no real alternative given a chance. A different outcome calls for a different approach.
items.body:
Israelis are still debating whether the recent report is true—whether the United Arab Emirates warned Israel of an imminent Hamas attack roughly 10 days before the Oct. 7 massacre.

But fixating on the few days before Oct. 7 obscures a deeper flaw: The Israeli mindset, the strategic conception, remains largely unchanged. It is conflict management. Israel is using a weakened and deterred Hamas ruling Gaza as an excuse to deepen the divide between Gaza and a Palestinian Authority–run West Bank. By avoiding allowing any alternative to emerge, it is sidelining the Palestinian question altogether.

If the deadliest disaster of Jews since the Holocaust should have changed one thing, it was this. Yet, strip away the rhetoric of “total victory,” and Israel’s Gaza policy today looks quite similar, just with more bloodshed and rubble.

In recent weeks, Israeli leaders have vowed to remain in Gaza for the long term and end Hamas’s rule once and for all. Following a string of successful assassinations of Hamas commanders, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Israel Katz declared: “Our message is clear: No terrorist is immune, and Hamas will not be in Gaza.”

Israel is using a weakened and deterred Hamas ruling Gaza as an excuse to deepen the divide between Gaza and a Palestinian Authority–run West Bank.

Weakening Hamas is legitimate, and so is Israel’s demand that it relinquish control of Gaza. But Israel’s revealed preference tells a different story.

Even as Israel holds an estimated 60 percent of Gaza, Hamas still controls over 95 percent of the population. Hamas is both a terrorist organization and Gaza’s de facto government; removing the former requires an alternative for the latter. Israel refused to hand that role to the Palestinian Authority but signed on to President Trump’s 20-point plan last year, which offers exactly that: a transition to the technocratic National Committee for the Administration of Gaza, eventually leading to a reformed Palestinian Authority.

The Israeli government apparently never intended to let that alternative emerge.

Members of the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza remain in Cairo, with no timeline for entering Gaza. Roughly 6,000 vetted police recruits, meant to begin training months ago, have not left Gaza because Israel will not commit to letting them return.

Construction of a base for the International Stabilization Force is stalled by bureaucracy. Reconstruction of the Israeli-held “Green Zone” meant to showcase non-Hamas governance hasn’t advanced. And in the West Bank, Israeli policy is weakening the Palestinian Authority toward collapse and carving the territory into cantons to ensure no Palestinian governance, with or without Gaza, is ever viable.

Hamas has expectedly stalled the plan, too. But in August it accepted the Board of Peace’s roadmap, listing 15 principles for phased disarmament in exchange for Israel Defense Forces withdrawal. Israel has valid concerns, including the roadmap’s timeline, scope of disarmament, and Qatar and Turkey’s role in verifying compliance.

A future Israeli government that wants a different outcome will have to act like it.

But justified skepticism does not excuse refusing to engage. Instead of making Hamas back its words, Israel has effectively handed it veto power over the process, drawing international blame for stalling while Hamas gains recognition as a legitimate partner.

Domestic politics explains much of this. Israel faces a charged election on Oct. 27, and Netanyahu’s coalition cannot show compromise on Gaza. Even pressure from Trump plays in his favor, as he claims to be the only one who can stand up to who he called “the greatest friend that the state of Israel has ever had in the White House.” Netanyahu’s rivals, meantime, are trying to outflank him from the right, vowing to keep fighting rather than engage the U.S.-led plan.

But whoever wins will still have to pick up the Trump framework. The alternatives—renewed full-scale war or a Gaza permanently split between an Israeli-held east and Hamas-run west—serve neither Israel’s security interests nor produce an acceptable status quo.

Rather than campaigning on the same hawkish instinct, prime minister contenders should say that the current approach only keeps Hamas in power: deterred, but not replaced, with no real alternative given a chance.

A future Israeli government that wants a different outcome will have to act like it. This means setting a political horizon instead of managing the conflict incident by incident, taking initiative on the Trump plan and disarmament roadmap instead of being dragged along by Washington, Cairo, or Doha.

It also requires letting the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza function and supporting Palestinian Authority reform rather than treating its flaws as a pretext for exclusion and redirecting Gaza’s financial lifelines to starve Hamas economically rather than merely bombing it.

Such a shift could unlock the funding, troops, and regional cooperation the plan needs, and begin restoring Israel’s ties with Europe and the Arab world.

A new government will find it hard to change course quickly. The only way to make that happen is U.S. leadership from the top, because whoever wins will want Trump on their side.

The ceasefire, the hostages’ return, and the 20-point framework a year ago were a major achievement. The Trump administration can use this anniversary and Israel’s election to press ahead. Otherwise, Israel risks drifting back into an Oct. 6 reality: a contained, managed Hamas quietly rebuilding behind a calm facade, primed to explode again.
zhParas: 以色列人仍在争论，最近的那则报道是否属实——阿拉伯联合酋长国是否在10月7日屠杀发生前约10天，就警告过以色列哈马斯即将发动袭击。
但把目光死盯在10月7日之前的这几天上，会掩盖一个更深层的缺陷：以色列人的思维方式和战略构想基本没有改变，那就是冲突管理。以色列正以被削弱、被威慑住的哈马斯统治加沙为借口，加深加沙与由巴勒斯坦权力机构管辖的约旦河西岸之间的裂痕。通过不让任何替代方案出现，它把巴勒斯坦问题整个边缘化了。
如果说大屠杀以来犹太人遭遇的最惨重灾难本应改变一件事，那就应该是这一点。然而，剥去“全面胜利”的说辞，以色列今天的加沙政策看上去并无二致，只是流血更多、废墟更多。
近几周，以色列领导人誓言要长期留在加沙，并彻底终结哈马斯的统治。在接连成功暗杀哈马斯指挥官之后，总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡（Benjamin Netanyahu）和国防部长伊斯雷尔·卡茨（Israel Katz）宣称：“我们的信息很明确：没有哪个恐怖分子可以豁免，哈马斯不会留在加沙。”
以色列正以被削弱、被威慑住的哈马斯统治加沙为借口，加深加沙与由巴勒斯坦权力机构管辖的约旦河西岸之间的裂痕。
削弱哈马斯是正当的，以色列要求其放弃对加沙的控制也是正当的。但以色列显露出的实际偏好却讲述了另一个故事。
尽管以色列控制着加沙约60%的地区，哈马斯仍控制着当地95%以上的人口。哈马斯既是恐怖组织，也是加沙事实上的政府；要铲除前者，就必须为后者提供替代方案。以色列拒绝把这一角色交给巴勒斯坦权力机构，但去年却签署了特朗普（Trump）总统的20点计划，而该计划提供的正是这一点：过渡到技术官僚性质的加沙行政管理全国委员会，最终走向改革后的巴勒斯坦权力机构。
以色列政府显然从未打算让这一替代方案出现。
加沙管理国家委员会成员仍留在开罗，没有进入加沙的时间表。大约6000名经过审查的警察新兵本应在数月前开始训练，但因以色列不愿承诺允许他们返回，至今未能离开加沙。
国际稳定部队基地的建设因官僚程序而停滞。以色列控制的“绿区”本意是展示非哈马斯治理，其重建毫无进展。在约旦河西岸，以色列的政策正削弱巴勒斯坦权力机构，使其走向崩溃，并将该地区切割成一块块飞地，以确保无论有无加沙，巴勒斯坦治理都永远无法可行。
哈马斯也不出所料地拖延了这一计划。但8月它接受了和平委员会的路线图，列出15项原则，以分阶段解除武装换取以色列国防军撤离。以色列的担忧不无道理，包括路线图的时间表、解除武装的范围，以及卡塔尔和土耳其在核查遵守情况方面的作用。
未来的以色列政府若想取得不同的结果，就必须以相应的方式行事。
但合理的怀疑并不能成为拒绝接触的借口。以色列没有迫使哈马斯兑现其言辞，反而实际上赋予其对这一进程的否决权，因拖延而招致国际指责，而哈马斯则获得合法伙伴的认可。
国内政治在很大程度上解释了这一切。以色列将于10月27日举行一场激烈的选举，内塔尼亚胡的联盟无法在加沙问题上展现妥协。就连特朗普施压也对他有利，因为他声称只有他才能顶住他所称的“以色列国在白宫有史以来最伟大的朋友”。与此同时，内塔尼亚胡的对手正试图从右翼包抄他，誓言继续战斗，而非参与美国主导的计划。
但无论谁获胜，都仍须接过特朗普的框架。其他选项——重启全面战争，或加沙永久分裂为以色列控制的东部和哈马斯控制的西部——既不符合以色列的安全利益，也无法形成可接受的现状。
总理职位角逐者不应以同样的鹰派本能进行竞选，而应指出：当前做法只会让哈马斯继续掌权——受到威慑，却未被取代，真正的替代方案从未获得机会。
未来一个想要不同结果的以色列政府，就必须以相应的方式行事。这意味着要设定政治前景，而不是逐次事件地管控冲突；要在特朗普计划和解除武装路线图上采取主动，而不是被华盛顿、开罗或多哈牵着走。
这还要求让加沙管理全国委员会能够运作，并支持巴勒斯坦权力机构改革，而不是将其缺陷当作排斥的借口，并将加沙的资金命脉转向在经济上扼杀哈马斯，而不只是对其进行轰炸。
这样的转变可能释放该计划所需的资金、部队和区域合作，并开始恢复以色列与欧洲和阿拉伯世界的关系。
新政府将很难迅速改变路线。要让这种情况发生，唯一办法是美国最高层发挥领导作用，因为无论谁获胜，都会希望特朗普站在自己一边。
一年前的停火、人质回归和20点框架是一项重大成就。特朗普政府可以利用这一周年和以色列选举来推进。否则，以色列可能重新滑回10月6日的现实：一个被遏制、被管控的哈马斯在平静表象背后悄然重建，随时准备再次爆发。

items.title: US to open two new military bases in Greenland, sources say
items.author: Stine Jacobsen, Erin Banco and Gram Slattery, Reuters
items.summary: The U.S. plans to re-establish a Cold War-era military base in southern Greenland and set up another on the east coast, according to sources.
items.body:
COPENHAGEN/WASHINGTON — The U.S. plans to re-establish a Cold War-era military base in southern Greenland and set up another on the east coast, now used by the Danish dog sled patrol, under a deal to be signed with Denmark and Greenland on Tuesday, according to three people familiar with the matter.

The sites are Narsarsuaq, whose population has dwindled to a few dozen people since the U.S. closed its Bluie West One military base in the 1950s, and Mestersvig, a military outpost used by the Sirius Dog Sled Patrol, a Danish special forces unit, said two of the people.

Denmark, Greenland and the United States are expected to sign their new agreement at the United Nations General Assembly in New York City at 10:30 a.m. ET (1430 GMT) on Tuesday.

The text of the agreement has not been made public and the three people familiar with the deal, speaking on condition of anonymity, said its details will not be finalized until it is signed.

The governments of Denmark and Greenland did not immediately respond to a request by Reuters for comment.

A White House spokesperson declined to comment on the details of the agreement, repeating an earlier statement that its signing on Tuesday would “secure and defend the security of Greenland and the United States.”

Denmark says the agreement puts Arctic security under the watch of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization, the military defense alliance, rather than leaving it solely to the U.S. and Denmark.

The deal follows months of pressure from U.S. President Donald Trump, who has long said he wants the U.S. to control Greenland and has at times refused to rule out military or economic force to acquire the semi-autonomous Danish territory. The idea has been rejected by an overwhelming majority of Greenlanders, polling shows.

Trump’s threats, which peaked in January, triggered a diplomatic crisis within NATO and pushed Denmark and Greenland into negotiations with Washington aimed at defusing the pressure.

During the Cold War, the US maintained 17 military installations and more than 10,000 personnel in Greenland. Today only Pituffik Space Base remains, with some 150 U.S. military personnel.
zhParas: 哥本哈根/华盛顿——据三名知情人士称，根据美国将于周二与丹麦和格陵兰签署的一项协议，美国计划在格陵兰岛南部重建一处冷战时期的军事基地，并在东海岸另设一处基地，后者目前由丹麦狗拉雪橇巡逻队使用。
其中两名知情人士称，这两处地点分别是纳萨尔苏瓦克（Narsarsuaq）和梅斯特斯维格（Mestersvig）。自美国在20世纪50年代关闭其Bluie West One军事基地以来，纳萨尔苏瓦克的人口已减少到几十人；梅斯特斯维格则是由丹麦特种部队天狼星狗拉雪橇巡逻队使用的一个军事前哨。
丹麦、格陵兰和美国预计将于周二在纽约联合国大会上签署这项新协议，时间为美国东部时间上午10:30（14:30 GMT）。
协议文本尚未公开，这三名熟悉该协议并要求匿名的人士表示，协议细节在签署前不会最终确定。
丹麦和格陵兰政府没有立即回应路透社的置评请求。
白宫发言人对协议细节不予置评，并重复了早些时候的声明，称周二签署该协议将“保障并捍卫格陵兰和美国的安全”。
丹麦表示，该协议将北极安全置于北约这一军事防务联盟的监督之下，而不是仅由美国和丹麦负责。
该协议是在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)数月施压之后达成的。他长期以来表示希望美国控制格陵兰，并且有时拒绝排除动用军事或经济力量来获取这块丹麦半自治领地的可能性。民调显示，绝大多数格陵兰人反对这一想法。
特朗普的威胁在1月达到顶峰，引发了北约内部的外交危机，并促使丹麦和格陵兰与华盛顿展开谈判，旨在缓解压力。
冷战期间，美国在格陵兰维持了17个军事设施和超过1万名人员。如今，仅存皮图菲克太空基地，驻有约150名美国军事人员。

items.title: Notice: Competition: Innovation Support to Operations (Cycle 8)
items.summary: This UKDI Themed Competition seeks innovative, cost competitive proposals that are designed for manufacture and scalable in twelve-months.
items.body:
This UK Defence Innovation (UKDI) themed competition is looking for innovative proposals that are cost competitive, designed for manufacture, and can be scaled in an approximate twelve-month timeframe.

This is Cycle 8 of a multiple cycle competition. Proposals submitted will follow the UKDI “How your proposal will be assessed” process with contracting immediately afterwards for successful proposals.

UKDI reserves the right to change or close the competition without launching further cycles.

Outputs from funded projects may be considered for further development or procurement, subject to contract. In this circumstance the Authority (Secretary of State for Defence, acting on behalf of the Crown) will undertake appropriate procurement activity to ensure value for money and subject to any applicable regulations that may be applicable.

Competition key information

Cycle 8: 12:00 Midday on 22 September 2026 (BST)

Funding limits and expectations

We are expecting proposals to cost no more than £350,000. A number of proposals may be funded. Your proposal must not exceed £1,000,000 (excluding VAT)

Technology Readiness Level (TRL)

Reach at least TRL 6 by the end of the project

Contract start month

Aim to start January 2027

Equal to or less than four months from the project start date

Cyber Risk Assessment (CRA) number and risk level

RAR-NAN6JZQ - Cyber Risk Profile Level 1

Feedback release date

Mid December 2026

See Section 14 Pre-sift Criteria

Where do I submit my proposal?

Via the UKDI Online Submission Service where you will need to register for an account. Only proposals submitted through the UKDI Online Submission Service will be accepted.
zhParas: 本次英国国防创新（UKDI）主题竞赛正在寻找具有成本竞争力、面向制造设计，并能在约十二个月时间框架内实现规模化的创新提案。
这是多轮竞赛的第8轮。提交的提案将遵循UKDI“如何评估您的提案”流程，成功提案随后将立即签订合同。
UKDI保留在不启动后续轮次的情况下更改或关闭竞赛的权利。
受资助项目的成果可能会被考虑用于进一步开发或采购，但须视合同而定。在这种情况下，主管机构（国防大臣，代表王室行事）将开展适当的采购活动，以确保资金效益，并遵守任何可能适用的法规。
竞赛关键信息
资助限额与预期
我们预计提案成本不超过350,000英镑。可能会有多个提案获得资助。您的提案不得超过1,000,000英镑（不含增值税）
技术成熟度等级（TRL）
到项目结束时至少达到 TRL 6
合同开始月份
目标是在 2027 年 1 月启动
自项目开始日期起不超过四个月
网络风险评估（CRA）编号和风险等级
RAR-NAN6JZQ - 网络风险概况等级 1
反馈发布日期

items.title: The Golden Dome czar must get control of all US missile defense programs
items.author: Thane Clare
items.summary: The Defense Department must heed a vital organizational lesson from the past if Golden Dome is to succeed, writes analyst Thane Clare.
items.body:
The United States is largely defenseless against Russian and Chinese aerial attacks. This is a major strategic problem in today’s era of massed drone and missile warfare—and no one is clearly in charge of solving it.

President Trump’s February 2025 executive order, “The Iron Dome for America” (later rebranded as Golden Dome), directed the Department of Defense to protect U.S. citizens and infrastructure from all forms of aerial attack. The department took a first step toward assigning responsibility for a U.S. air and missile defense architecture by standing up the Golden Dome office. But critical elements of any near-term defensive shield remain outside its control: namely, the U.S. air and missile defense systems that have proven their worth on Ukrainian and Middle Eastern battlefields.

The Aegis system, for example, is a U.S. Navy program—though its ballistic missile defense component is funded by the Missile Defense Agency (MDA). Patriot interceptors, in turn, belong to the Army. Theater High Altitude Aerial Defense (THAAD) batteries and the Ground Based Midcourse Defense System (GMDS) are developed by the MDA but operated and maintained by the Army. U.S. Northern Command is responsible for U.S. air surveillance but relies heavily on radars belonging to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) — and so on.

The Golden Dome director’s position in the Defense Department hierarchy — reporting directly to the Deputy Secretary of Defense — reflects the urgency of the task. But it does not convey any actual authority to direct the decisions of the Army, Navy, Air Force, or Transportation secretaries.

Diffusion of responsibility is a recipe for failure.

For Golden Dome to work, the Defense Department must draw on lessons from some of its most successful Cold War innovations — specifically, the organizational innovations that made its game-changing technologies and operational concepts possible. Admiral Hyman Rickover, perhaps the leading exemplar of Cold War innovation, took nuclear propulsion from the blackboard to the fleet in just five years.

To quote Rickover: “Unless you can point your finger at the one person who is responsible when something goes wrong, then you have never had anyone really responsible.” Golden Dome fails this test, precisely because — according to the Defense Department itself — it is a “team effort” in which “we’re going to need all the services and agencies that do this kind of work to step up.”

Rickover took the opposite approach. If something was critical to the Navy’s nuclear propulsion program, he established de facto (and often de jure) control over it. For example, he successfully co-opted the Cabinet-level Atomic Energy Commission. Established in 1947 to oversee all U.S. nuclear matters, the AEC was a potential bureaucratic roadblock. At Rickover’s prompting, therefore, the Navy issued him orders to “report for duty with the Division of Reactor Development” in the AEC (and to the Navy for “additional duty”).

With one foot in the Navy and the other in the AEC, Rickover became the central U.S. authority for nuclear propulsion. This allowed him to coordinate the activities of two separate executive departments, often by proposing an action from one department and then convincing the other to approve it. His dual office, Naval Reactors, remains part of both the Navy and the Department of Energy (successor to the AEC) to this day.

The Rickover approach is not how the Pentagon normally does business. “I can assure you,” Rickover told Congress in 1979, “that having one individual responsible for a total program is a unique concept within the Department of Defense.” But Rickover made it his business to acquire unchallenged authority over all areas that concerned “his” reactors.

The Secretary of Defense must likewise assign total responsibility for Golden Dome, with autonomy and authority to match. This will entail taking the requisite authorities from their normal stewards and re-delegating them to the Golden Dome director.

For example, ballistic missile defense responsibility is currently bifurcated between Golden Dome and the Missile Defense Agency. MDA should be moved under Golden Dome. Similarly, airspace surveillance operations and modernization are divided between DoD and the FAA, with the latter contributing the lion’s share. The Golden Dome director must have a Rickover-like dual assignment in the FAA. And if homeland defense is indeed an urgent priority, DoD should take a hard look at whether the Aegis and Patriot programs should be moved under Golden Dome as well.

This process will be challenging, but far from impossible. And while Rickover’s nuclear power program is one of the most remarkable Cold War innovations, other success stories such as General Bernard Schriever’s Atlas ICBM and Undersecretary of Defense William Perry’s F-117 stealth fighter applied the same core insight: comprehensive organizational authority is just as important as any technological or industrial-base factor. DoD must heed this lesson if Golden Dome is to succeed.

Thane Clare is a Senior Fellow at the Center for Strategic and Budgetary Assessments.
zhParas: 美国对俄罗斯和中国的空中攻击基本上无法防御。在当今大规模无人机和导弹作战时代，这是一个重大战略问题——而且没有明确由谁负责解决这一问题。
特朗普（Trump）总统2025年2月的行政令“美国铁穹”（后改称“金穹顶”）指示国防部保护美国公民和基础设施免受一切形式的空中攻击。国防部通过设立金穹顶办公室，朝着为美国防空反导架构明确责任迈出了第一步。但近期任何防御盾牌的关键要素仍不在其控制之下：即那些已在乌克兰和中东战场证明自身价值的美国防空和导弹防御系统。
例如，宙斯盾系统是美国海军项目——尽管其弹道导弹防御组成部分由导弹防御局（MDA）出资。反过来，“爱国者”拦截弹属于陆军。战区高空空中防御（THAAD）发射连和陆基中段防御系统（GMDS）由MDA开发，但由陆军操作和维护。美军北方司令部负责美国对空监视，却严重依赖属于美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）的雷达——诸如此类。
金穹顶主任在国防部层级中的位置——直接向国防部副部长汇报——反映了任务的紧迫性。但这并未赋予其任何实际权力去主导陆军、海军、空军或交通部长的决策。
责任分散必然招致失败。
金穹顶若要奏效，国防部必须汲取其冷战时期一些最成功创新——具体而言，是那些使其颠覆性技术和作战概念成为可能的组织创新——的经验教训。或许堪称冷战创新首要典范的海军上将海曼·里科弗（Hyman Rickover）仅用五年就把核动力从黑板带到了舰队。
引用里科弗的话：“除非出了问题时你能把手指指向那个唯一负责的人，否则你就从未有过真正负责的人。”金穹顶未能通过这一检验，恰恰是因为——按国防部自己的说法——它是一项“团队努力”，其中“我们将需要所有从事这类工作的军种和机构挺身而出。”
里科弗采取了相反的做法。如果某事物对海军核动力计划至关重要，他就会对其建立事实上的（且往往是法律上的）控制。例如，他成功地将内阁级别的原子能委员会（AEC）收归己用。AEC成立于1947年，负责监管美国所有核事务，是一个潜在的官僚障碍。因此，在里科弗的推动下，海军向他下达命令，要求他“到AEC的反应堆开发司报到履职”（并向海军报到，承担“额外职责”）。
里科弗 (Rickover) 一只脚在海军，另一只脚在 AEC，成为美国核动力领域的核心权威。这使他能够协调两个独立行政部门的活动，往往是从一个部门提出一项行动，然后说服另一个部门予以批准。他那个双重归属的机构——海军反应堆——至今仍同时隶属于海军和能源部（AEC 的继任机构）。
里科弗的做法并非五角大楼通常的办事方式。里科弗在 1979 年对国会说：“我可以向你们保证，让一个人对一个完整项目负责，这在国防部内部是一个独特的概念。”但里科弗把获得对一切涉及“他的”反应堆领域的无可争议的权威当作自己的使命。
国防部长必须同样为“金穹”赋予全面责任，并给予与之匹配的自主权和权限。这将需要把必要的权限从通常的主管机构手中收回，并重新授予“金穹”主任。
例如，弹道导弹防御职责目前在“金穹”和导弹防御局（MDA）之间被一分为二。MDA 应被划归“金穹”之下。同样，空域监视行动和现代化在国防部和 FAA 之间分割，其中后者承担了最大份额。“金穹”主任必须在 FAA 拥有类似里科弗式的双重任命。如果本土防御确实是一项紧迫优先事项，国防部还应认真审视是否也应把 Aegis 和 Patriot 项目划归“金穹”之下。
这一过程将充满挑战，但远非不可能。尽管里科弗的核动力项目是冷战时期最非凡的创新之一，但其他成功案例，例如伯纳德·施里弗将军 (Bernard Schriever) 的 Atlas ICBM 和国防部副部长威廉·佩里 (William Perry) 的 F-117 隐形战斗机，都运用了同样的核心洞见：全面的组织权限与任何技术或工业基础因素同等重要。如果“金穹”要取得成功，国防部必须吸取这一教训。
塞恩·克莱尔 (Thane Clare) 是战略与预算评估中心的高级研究员。

items.title: UK military support to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
items.summary: The UK will provide additional defensive military support to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia following renewed Houthi attacks and escalating violence in the region.
items.body:
The UK will provide additional defensive military support to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia following renewed Houthi attacks and escalating violence in the region.

Following a request from the Saudi Arabian Government, the UK has agreed to provide an RAF Voyager air-to-air refuelling aircraft to support Saudi defensive activity in support of the legitimate government of Yemen.

Escalating tensions in the Gulf can have a serious impact at home in the UK – increasing prices, disruption to energy supplies, and extra costs for British businesses. The Houthis are a dangerous threat to regional stability in the Middle East, and it is in the UK’s national economic and security interest that they do not succeed.

We unequivocally condemn the Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and are clear that the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the Republic of Yemen have the right to defend themselves.

The support builds on the UK’s existing military contribution to Saudi Arabia’s air defence, including the deployment of air defence equipment and UK personnel helping to protect against missile and drone attacks.

Saudi Arabia and Yemen are long-standing partners of the United Kingdom and play a vital role in regional stability. It is in the UK’s interest to protect regional stability, protecting vital trade and energy supplies and encouraging a diplomatic resolution to the conflict in Yemen.

应沙特阿拉伯政府的请求，英国已同意提供一架皇家空军 Voyager 空中加油机，以支持沙特为支持也门合法政府而开展的防御行动。
海湾地区紧张局势不断升级，可能对英国国内造成严重影响——推高物价、扰乱能源供应，并给英国企业带来额外成本。胡塞武装是对中东地区稳定的危险威胁，阻止其得逞符合英国的国家经济和安全利益。
我们明确谴责胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯的袭击，并明确表示，沙特阿拉伯王国和也门共和国有权自卫。
这一支持建立在英国对沙特阿拉伯防空现有军事贡献的基础上，包括部署防空装备和英国人员，协助抵御导弹和无人机袭击。
沙特阿拉伯和也门是英国的长期伙伴，在地区稳定中发挥着至关重要的作用。维护地区稳定、保护关键贸易和能源供应，并推动通过外交途径解决也门冲突，符合英国的利益。

items.title: Air Force to Get First Next-Gen Tactical C2 Centers By Year’s End
items.author: Todd South
items.summary: A single-pallet-sized tactical operations center is slated to begin shipping to 70 Air Force units by the end of the year following a recent announcement by the company that made it and the Air Force entity responsible for its development. The post Air Force to Get First Next-Gen Tactical C2 Centers By Year’s End appeared first on Air & Space Forces Magazine .
items.body:
NATIONAL HARBOR, Md.—The first of 70 single-pallet-sized tactical operations centers are slated to begin shipping to Air Force units by the end of the year following a recent announcement by the company that made it and the Air Force entity responsible for its development.

The Tactical Operations Center-Light is the Air Force’s next-generation method for conducting ground-based air battle management Several years ago, the service contracted with Lockheed Martin and L3Harris to build the first 16 prototypes of the TOC-L, which started delivering in 2023.

In 2025, though, the Air Force tapped Booz Allen Hamilton for a $315 million rapid prototyping contract to scale and produce the second iteration of the TOC-L, dubbed MR2 for Major Release 2 or Material Release 2.

The initial 16 MR1 prototypes let Airmen to get their hands on a prototype system and test it out. MR2 is the kit that will be in place to run air battle management in the near term.

“Material Release 1 is, ‘hey, how do we get the capability they need now so they can fight tonight?” Brig. Gen. Joshua Williams, program acquisition executive for command, control, communications, and battle management, told reporters Sept. 16 at AFA’s Air, Space & Cyber conference. “Material Release 2 is focused on deeper integration, improved edge connectivity, and more mature support.”

The system connects to all major aircraft and capabilities the Air Force deploys and can work backward-compatible through the DAF Battle Network, Patrick Hamilton, vice president for defense technology at Booz, told Air & Space Forces Magazine at the conference.

“This is the next-generation C2 system that the Air Force is going to deploy that hopefully will be in place for the next 30 to 40 years for the new C2 fight,” Hamilton said.

Because the TOC-L system can incorporate software changes more readily than legacy ground systems such as the Control and Reporting Center, it can more quickly add in capabilities, applications, and other items from the DAF Battle Network as it grows and more options are added.

“That is the fundamental difference to the prior prototype,” Hamilton said. “Now you’ll be able to, in the future, iterate as future improvements go online in the Battle Network.”

Operational Air Force units have spent the past year taking and testing TOC-L systems “downrange,” Col. Bai Lan Zhu, senior materiel leader for the Advanced Battle Management System, told reporters during the conference media session.

The total number of TOC-Ls to flow across the entire Air Force is still evolving, Zhu said.

“The exact quantities are something that the operational community is going to refine over time,” she said.

The first wave of TOC-Ls will begin shipping to units by or before December. The company plans to deliver 70 units under the current contract, Hamilton said.

The new system can also draw from at least three “enclaves” of data, letting users fuse information from both classified and unclassified sources more easily.

“So, if you have something coming in, let’s say from an FAA unclassified radar, and you want to put that on the situational awareness [common operating picture] that the user is looking at, which is in a secret enclave, you need the ability to move that data up,” Hamilton said.

The TOC-L provides that ability.

The system can also render those enclaves unclassified when powered off, based on National Security Agency data-at-rest standards.

In the past, system users would spend hours at the end of each mission or shift physically removing a series of drives, labeling them and storing them according to protocols, only to have to rebuild the setup the next day, Mike Lewis, Booz’s chief engineer for TOC-L, told Air & Space Forces Magazine.

“There are a lot of logistics and risk in that type of scenario, so with data at rest being unclassified, it’s a real key to making this tactically relevant from a speed perspective and from a cyber perspective,” Lewis said.

Fewer Pieces, Fewer People

TOC-L replaces the Cold War-era Control and Reporting Center, previously centered around the trusty but bulky AN/TPS-75 radar system.

The legacy system required as many as six C-17 Globemaster IIIs to transport all of its components, using radar dishes, heavy vehicles, and nearly two dozen power generators.

The CRC would require hundreds of Airmen to set up and operate and could take between 24 and 72 hours to set up and tear down.

TOC-L is a feather by comparison.

It fits on a single pallet, with one additional pallet to hold its generator; can be transported inside a single C-130 Hercules; requires about 10 Airmen to operate; and can be set up or torn down in less than an hour.

The TOC-L can squeeze into such a small frame and use far fewer people, partly because of advances in electronics and partly because it can tap into the DAF Battle Network and other networks to access radar and other feeds instead of carrying its own radars into the fight.

The shift in allowing nonproprietary equipment to hook into the TOC-L system also drastically trims down the amount of hardware needed to operate the system’s crucial functions, Hamilton told Air & Space Forces Magazine.

“We’re going to collect iterative feedback from ABMS and the user community as it deploys all over the world,” said Hamilton. “And I think over the next 12 to 24 months, that will start to define what [Material Release 3] will look like and what we hear from the user community, what they prioritize for.”
zhParas: 马里兰州国家港——在制造该系统的公司以及负责其研发的空军机构最近发布公告后，70个单托盘大小的战术作战中心中的首批定于今年年底前开始向空军部队发运。
Tactical Operations Center-Light 是美国空军进行地基空战管理的下一代方法。数年前，美国空军与 Lockheed Martin 和 L3Harris 签订合同，建造首批16个 TOC-L 原型，并于2023年开始交付。
不过，2025年，美国空军选择 Booz Allen Hamilton 签订一份价值3.15亿美元的快速原型合同，以扩大规模并生产 TOC-L 的第二迭代版本，代号 MR2，即 Major Release 2 或 Material Release 2。
最初的16个 MR1 原型让空军人员能够接触原型系统并进行测试。MR2 是近期将部署到位、用于执行空战管理的套件。

“Material Release 1 是，‘嘿，我们如何让他们现在获得所需能力，以便他们今晚就能作战？’”负责指挥、控制、通信和战斗管理的项目采办执行官 Brig. Gen. 乔舒亚·威廉姆斯（Joshua Williams）9月16日在美国空军协会的 Air, Space & Cyber 会议上告诉记者。“Material Release 2 侧重于更深入的集成、改进的边缘连接以及更成熟的支持。”
该系统可连接美国空军部署的所有主要飞机和能力，并能通过 DAF Battle Network 实现向后兼容运行，Booz 负责防务技术的副总裁帕特里克·汉密尔顿（Patrick Hamilton）在会议期间告诉《Air & Space Forces Magazine》。
“这是美国空军将部署的下一代 C2 系统，有望在未来30至40年用于新的 C2 作战，”汉密尔顿说。
由于 TOC-L 系统比控制与报告中心等传统地面系统更容易纳入软件更改，因此随着 DAF Battle Network 不断扩展并加入更多选项，它能更快地添加来自该网络的能力、应用程序和其他项目。
“这是与之前原型机的根本区别，”汉密尔顿（Hamilton）说。“今后，随着战斗网络中的后续改进陆续上线，你将能够进行迭代。”
过去一年，美国空军作战部队一直在“前沿”接收并测试 TOC-L 系统，先进战斗管理系统高级装备主管朱白兰上校（Col. Bai Lan Zhu）在会议媒体吹风会上对记者说。
朱白兰说，将列装整个空军的 TOC-L 总数仍在变化之中。
“具体数量将由作战部门随着时间推移逐步厘清，”她说。
首批 TOC-L 将在 12 月或之前开始向部队交付。汉密尔顿说，公司计划按现有合同交付 70 套。
新系统还可以从至少三个数据“飞地”中调取数据，使用户能够更轻松地融合涉密与非密来源的信息。
“所以，如果有一条数据进来，比如说来自美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）的非密雷达，而你想把它放到用户正在看的态势感知[通用作战图]上，而后者处于一个涉密飞地中，你就需要有能力把该数据向上传输，”汉密尔顿说。
TOC-L 就提供了这种能力。
该系统在断电时还可依据美国国家安全局的静态数据标准，将这些隔离区设为非密。
过去，系统用户会在每次任务或轮班结束时花费数小时，物理拆下一系列驱动器，按规程给它们贴标签并存放，结果第二天又不得不重新搭建整套配置，Booz 公司 TOC-L 首席工程师迈克·刘易斯（Mike Lewis）告诉《空军与太空军杂志》。
“这类场景涉及大量后勤工作和风险，因此，静态数据为非密，对于从速度角度和网络角度使其具备战术相关性而言是一个真正的关键，”刘易斯说。
部件更少，人员更少
TOC-L 取代了冷战时代的控制与报告中心，后者此前以可靠但笨重的 AN/TPS-75 雷达系统为核心。
这套旧系统需要多达六架 C-17 Globemaster III 来运输其所有组件，包括雷达天线、重型车辆和近 24 台发电机。
CRC 需要数百名空军人员来搭建和操作，且搭建和拆除可能需要 24 至 72 小时。
相比之下，TOC-L 轻若羽毛。
它可装在一个货盘上，另有一个货盘用于放置其发电机；可由一架 C-130 Hercules 运输；操作约需10名空军人员；并可在不到一小时内完成架设或撤收。
TOC-L 能压缩到如此小的框架内，并使用远少得多的人员，部分原因是电子设备的进步，部分原因是它能接入 DAF Battle Network 和其他网络，以获取雷达和其他数据馈送，而无需将自身雷达带入战斗。
汉密尔顿（Hamilton）对《Air & Space Forces Magazine》表示，允许非专有设备接入 TOC-L 系统的这一转变，也大幅削减了运行该系统关键功能所需的硬件数量。
“随着它在全球部署，我们将从 ABMS 和用户群体收集迭代反馈，”汉密尔顿说。“而且我认为，在未来 12 到 24 个月内，这将开始界定 [Material Release 3] 将是什么样子，以及我们从用户群体那里听到什么、他们优先考虑什么。”

items.title: General Atomics delivers FQ-42 Vengeance to Nevada air base
items.author: Cristina Stassis
items.summary: Creech Air Force Base received a new FQ-42 Vengeance aircraft on Friday, with the jet to continue regular test and evaluation operations.
items.body:
A Nevada Air Force Base was picked to house General Atomics’ FQ-42, a week after the U.S. Air Force dubbed the Collaborative Combat Aircraft as Vengeance.

On Friday, a new FQ-42 Vengeance aircraft was delivered to Creech Air Force Base, according to a Monday company release, and will continue regular test and evaluation operations to experiment with the new jet.

“Every week, the Air Force is pushing forward with new and more impressive accomplishments using Vengeance. It’s amazing to think of how far this program has come in such a short amount of time,” Vice President of Advanced Programs Mike Atwood said in the release.

The announcement follows two months after Creech conducted an Agile Combat Employment exercise using Anduril’s FQ-44 Fury, allowing airmen to carry out sorties and build foundational tactics and procedures that will mold how CCA are integrated into the force.

Anduril has yet to announce which Air Force base will house Fury.

Vengeance, which has an internal weapons bay and other low observability and boosted survivability features, flew alongside F-35 and F-15E Strike Eagles in preparation for collaborative control operations with manned aircraft, per the statement.

Recently, Secretary of the Air Force Troy Meink revealed that the service expects to have at least 500 autonomous aircraft in service by 2032, with them meant to perform many of the same missions manned fighters complete currently.

“By then, our special operators will have the ability to employ thousands of autonomous one-way attack systems, and we will have autonomous fighters like the Collaborative Combat Aircraft,” Meink said during last week’s keynote address at the Air & Space Forces Association’s 2026 Air, Space & Cyber Conference.

General Atomics said the company completed a new “low-observable paint facility” aimed at supporting CCA production with increased manufacturing space, and the company is on track to deliver six aircraft per month.

Vengeance’s production is underway on General Atomics’ dime as “government funding plans mature,” per the statement, in an effort to prevent delays in delivery.

The service’s fiscal 2027 request included $996.5 million in procurement funding for the CCA program. It also requests $150 million in advanced procurement for the following fiscal year and $1.37 billion in continued research and development. The total program request is $2.37 billion.

Cristina Stassis is a reporter covering stories surrounding the defense industry, national security, military/veteran affairs and more. She previously worked as an editorial fellow for Defense News in 2024 where she assisted the newsroom in breaking news across Sightline Media Group.
zhParas: 内华达州一处空军基地被选中部署通用原子公司的 FQ-42，此前一周，美国空军将协同作战飞机命名为 Vengeance。
据周一发布的一份公司新闻稿，一架新的 FQ-42 Vengeance 飞机于周五交付至克里奇空军基地，并将继续开展定期测试与评估行动，以试验这款新喷气式飞机。
“每周，空军都在借助 Vengeance 取得新的、更令人瞩目的成就。想到这个项目在如此短的时间内已取得如此进展，令人惊叹，”先进项目副总裁迈克·阿特伍德（Mike Atwood）在新闻稿中表示。
这一宣布距克里奇空军基地使用安杜里尔公司的 FQ-44 Fury 举行“敏捷作战运用”演习两个月后作出。该演习使空军人员得以执行架次，并建立基础战术和程序，这些将塑造 CCA 融入部队的方式。
安杜里尔公司尚未宣布哪个空军基地将部署 Fury。
声明称，Vengeance 拥有内部武器舱以及其他低可观测性和提升生存能力的特征，曾与 F-35 和 F-15E Strike Eagles 一同飞行，为与有人驾驶飞机开展协同控制行动做准备。
近日，美国空军部长特洛伊·迈因克（Troy Meink）透露，空军预计到 2032 年将至少有 500 架自主飞机服役，这些飞机旨在执行目前有人驾驶战斗机所完成的许多相同任务。
“到那时，我们的特种作战人员将有能力使用数千套自主单向攻击系统，而且我们将拥有像协同作战飞机这样的自主战斗机，”迈因克在上周美国航空航天部队协会 2026 年航空、航天与网络会议的主旨演讲中表示。
通用原子公司表示，该公司已完成一座新的“低可探测性涂装设施”，旨在通过扩大制造空间来支持 CCA 生产，且该公司有望每月交付六架飞机。
根据声明，随着“政府资助计划逐步成熟”，Vengeance 的生产正由通用原子公司自行出资推进，以防止交付延误。
该军种2027财年请求中包括为 CCA 计划申请的9.965亿美元采购经费。它还申请了下一财年的1.5亿美元预先采购经费以及13.7亿美元持续研发经费。该计划请求总额为23.7亿美元。

items.title: Software for New F-35 Logistics System Starts Going Live
items.author: Steve Losey
items.summary: The rollout of new hardware to replace an old, troubled maintenance and logistics system for the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter is complete, a Lockheed Martin spokesperson told reporters Sept. 14, and software upgrades are next. The post Software for New F-35 Logistics System Starts Going Live appeared first on Air & Space Forces Magazine .
items.body:
NATIONAL HARBOR, Md.—The effort to replace the F-35’s old, troubled maintenance and logistics system is picking up steam after years of work, a Lockheed Martin spokesperson told reporters Sept. 14, with new computer hardware fielded across the fleet and updated software starting to roll out.

Mireya Villarreal, Lockheed Martin’s spokesperson for the F-35 program, told reporters at AFA’s Air, Space & Cyber conference last week that software upgrades for the Operational Data Integrated Network, or ODIN, have recently begun, and “that transition is going well.”

Sean Jackson, vice president for Lockheed’s F-35 development program, said in a follow-up statement that the ODIN software was installed at Nellis Air Force Base, Nev., in late August. This marked the first operational delivery of ODIN software, he said.

“The new ODIN software takes advantage of capabilities based on recent fleetwide ODIN hardware upgrades to support F-35 fleet operations,” Jackson said. “Lockheed Martin continues to work hand-in-hand with our Air Force partners, aligning the ODIN software upgrade cadence that will cascade new and upgraded capabilities across the fleet.”

ODIN is replacing a previous system called ALIS, for Autonomic Logistics Information System. ALIS was meant to schedule and track F-35 maintenance, keep an eye on which jets were ready to fly, and help the military order spare parts, as well as tracking data in-flight and sending information on how well various systems were performing to maintainers on the ground.

But ALIS was deeply flawed. A 2020 Government Accountability Office report found crucial data that ALIS was supposed to automatically collect was often inaccurate or misleading. This forced maintainers to keep track of that information themselves, sometimes manually entering data in Excel spreadsheets in a time-consuming way.

Its interface was hard to navigate and not user-friendly, and its server units were massive, weighing in at 200 pounds apiece. The entire system weighed nearly 900 pounds and needed a whole room to operate, which officials said made ALIS difficult to deploy or store on a ship.

In 2020, the F-35 Joint Program Office announced Lockheed would design and build ODIN to replace ALIS. Officials say ODIN weighs less than a quarter of the entire ALIS system, has improved computer processing time, and is more secure and easier to service and support. The Pentagon started rolling out new hardware, called ODIN Base Kits, to F-35 squadrons in 2022. The kit can run both the ALIS and ODIN software.

Back in February, the F-35 program office issued a contract modification worth up to $47.7 million to Lockheed for further work on ODIN. Since 2020, the Pentagon has spent $255.1 million under the indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract, which has a ceiling of $309.3 million.
zhParas: 马里兰州国家港——洛克希德·马丁公司一位发言人9月14日告诉记者，在多年工作之后，替换F-35老旧且问题缠身的维护与后勤系统的努力正在加速推进；新的计算机硬件已在全机队部署，更新后的软件也开始推出。
洛克希德·马丁公司F-35项目发言人米雷娅·比利亚雷亚尔（Mireya Villarreal）上周在美国空军协会（AFA）的航空、航天与网络大会上告诉记者，作战数据集成网络（Operational Data Integrated Network，简称ODIN）的软件升级最近已经开始，而且“这一过渡进展顺利”。
洛克希德公司F-35研发项目副总裁肖恩·杰克逊（Sean Jackson）在随后的一份声明中表示，ODIN软件已于8月下旬在内华达州内利斯空军基地安装。他说，这标志着ODIN软件首次实现作战交付。
杰克逊说：“新的ODIN软件利用基于近期全机队ODIN硬件升级的能力，来支持F-35机队运行。洛克希德·马丁公司继续与我们的空军伙伴携手合作，协调ODIN软件升级节奏，从而将新的和升级后的能力逐步推广到整个机队。”
ODIN正在取代此前的系统ALIS，即自主后勤信息系统（Autonomic Logistics Information System）。ALIS原本用于安排和跟踪F-35的维护工作，监控哪些战机已准备好飞行，帮助军方订购备件，并在飞行中跟踪数据，将各系统运行状况的信息发送给地面维护人员。
但ALIS存在严重缺陷。美国政府问责局2020年的一份报告发现，ALIS本应自动收集的关键数据往往不准确或具有误导性。这迫使维护人员自行跟踪这些信息，有时还要以耗时的方式手动将数据录入Excel电子表格。
其界面难以操作且不友好，服务器单元体积庞大，每个重达200 pounds。整个系统重近900 pounds，需要占用整个房间才能运行；官员们表示，这使得ALIS难以在舰上部署或存放。
2020年，F-35联合项目办公室宣布，洛克希德公司将设计并建造ODIN以取代ALIS。官员们表示，ODIN的重量不到整个ALIS系统的四分之一，计算机处理时间有所改善，而且更安全，也更容易维护和保障。五角大楼于2022年开始向F-35中队推出名为ODIN Base Kits的新硬件。该套件可同时运行ALIS和ODIN软件。
今年2月，F-35项目办公室向洛克希德公司签发了一份价值最高达4770万美元的合同修改，用于进一步推进ODIN相关工作。自2020年以来，五角大楼已根据这份不定交付/不定数量合同支出2.551亿美元，该合同上限为3.093亿美元。

items.title: Connecting the fight: AFA 2026 panel explores next-generation DAF battle management
items.author: Senior Airman Malia Heemsoth
items.summary: As the Department of the Air Force works to build a more connected and resilient Battle Network, military and industry leaders focused on one central challenge: how to move capability to the warfighter faster.
items.body:
Published Sept. 21, 2026

By Senior Airman Malia Heemsoth

Secretary of the Air Force Public Affairs

As the Department of the Air Force works to build a more connected and resilient Battle Network , military and industry leaders focused on one central challenge: how to move capability to the warfighter faster during a panel at the Air and Space Forces Association’s Air, Space & Cyber Conference, Sept. 15.

The “Next-Generation Battle Management” panel brought together Elaine Bitonti of Collins Aerospace; retired Maj. Gen. Scott Jobe with Boeing; retired Col. Sean Lowe with SAIC; and retired Maj. Luke Savoie with Elbit America. Brig. Gen. Joshua Williams , the Department of the Air Force portfolio acquisition executive for Command, Control, Communications and Battle Management, moderated the panel.

Williams opened by emphasizing the need to move beyond systems that operate independently of one another.

“The Department of the Air Force will not accept business models built on closed software stacks, black box hardware or restricted data interfaces,” Williams said. “The government must own and govern the technical baseline to ensure rapid iterative upgrades.”

For Savoie, that openness must extend from architecture to technology operating at the edge of the fight.

“How do you solve the compute portion on the edge, so that these tools and the connected network is working further and further forward and faster and faster within the loop of the folks that are on the front edge?” Savoie asked.

Bitonti connected that challenge directly to the movement of data across the force.

“I think first, you know, we understand from a battle management perspective, it’s all about how we’re moving the data,” Bitonti said, explaining that separating software from hardware and creating flexible communications architectures can allow systems to adapt as new requirements emerge.

That flexibility, the panelists agreed, is only useful if the DAF can test and field new capabilities quickly.

“One of the keys I think for the government is rapid prototyping, demonstrations and ensuring that we have industry partnerships,” Jobe said. “In order to really prove it to the DAF Battle Network or to the Joint Force, you got to go out there and demonstrate it, show that it’s real.”

Jobe pointed to a recent example in which an AMRAAM was launched from an MQ-28 Ghost Bat and integrated with an E-7 Wedgetail and F/A-18 Hornet within nine months.

“So that’s one example of the many things we’re doing and the rapid prototyping and getting to the field to demonstrate capabilities,” Jobe said.

The panel then turned to one of the biggest barriers between development and operational use: testing, security and accreditation.

Lowe described a process where software can move through development, security compliance, developmental testing and operational testing in sequence, with each transition potentially adding weeks or months.

“This is how you get months and years of delay,” Lowe said. He pointed to an approach where developmental and operational testers work alongside developers, allowing changes to be identified and addressed much earlier. “By putting the DTOT folks in the right places, particularly with the developmental teams, we can accelerate this.”

“The ATO process is … one, it’s out of control of most of the people in program office, and when you get to it, it does bring everything to a screeching halt,” Savoie said, calling for a broader examination of cybersecurity, information technology security and accreditation processes.

Jobe similarly pointed to the security environment as an area where policy and decision-making could move faster.

“I think we could probably move a lot faster,” Jobe said. “Maybe some communication and education to the personnel that are inside the acquisition system might be beneficial.”

For Bitonti, data sharing between services and coalition partners presents another policy challenge.

“We talk about really wanting to operate as a joint force and also with our coalition partners, but there are multiple restrictions, policy restrictions on rule sets of what data we can and can’t share,” she said.

“At this point, it’s not actually a technological impediment that is causing some of our struggles sharing data. It’s policy impediments.”

As the panel closed, Williams brought the discussion back to the DAF’s responsibility to deliver capability at the pace required by an evolving fight.

“Acquisition is a warfighting function,” Williams said. “We must deliver open, resilient, software-driven capability at the speed of operational relevance.”

作者：Senior Airman Malia Heemsoth
空军部长公共事务办公室
在空军部着力构建更加互联、更具韧性的“战斗网络”（Battle Network）之际，军方和业界领袖于9月15日在空军与太空军协会“空中、太空与网络大会”的一场专题讨论上，聚焦一个核心难题：如何更快地把作战能力送到作战人员手中。
“下一代战斗管理”专题讨论汇集了柯林斯航空航天公司的Elaine Bitonti、波音公司的退役Maj. Gen. Scott Jobe、SAIC公司的退役Col. Sean Lowe，以及埃尔比特美国公司的退役Maj. Luke Savoie。空军部负责指挥、控制、通信与战斗管理组合采办事务的Brig. Gen. Joshua Williams主持了讨论。
Williams在开场发言中强调，必须超越那些各自独立运行的系统。
Williams说：“空军部不会接受建立在封闭软件栈、黑箱硬件或受限数据接口之上的商业模式。政府必须拥有并管理技术基线，以确保快速迭代升级。”
在Savoie看来，这种开放性必须从体系架构延伸到在作战前沿运行的技术。
“你如何解决边缘的计算部分，从而使这些工具和互联网络在最前沿人员的循环中越来越靠前、越来越快地运行？”萨沃伊（Savoie）问道。
比通蒂（Bitonti）将这一挑战直接与部队中数据的移动联系起来。
“我认为，首先，你知道，从战斗管理角度看，我们明白关键在于我们如何移动数据，”比通蒂说，并解释称，将软件与硬件分离并创建灵活的通信架构，可以让系统在新需求出现时进行适应。
小组成员一致认为，这种灵活性只有在DAF能够快速测试和部署新能力时才有用。
“我认为，对政府而言，关键之一在于快速原型开发、演示，并确保我们拥有行业合作伙伴关系，”乔布（Jobe）说。“为了真正向DAF战斗网络或联合部队证明它，你必须走出去演示它，表明它是真实的。”
乔布指出最近的一个例子：一枚AMRAAM从一架MQ-28 Ghost Bat上发射，并在九个月内与一架E-7 Wedgetail和F/A-18 Hornet完成集成。
“因此，这只是我们所做众多事情中的一个例子，也是快速原型开发和进入实地演示能力的一个例子，”乔布说。
随后，小组转向研发与作战使用之间最大的障碍之一：测试、安全和认证。
洛(Lowe)描述了一个流程：软件会依次经过开发、安全合规、开发测试和作战测试，而每一次转段都可能增加数周或数月的时间。
“这就是为什么会出现数月乃至数年的延误，”洛(Lowe)说。他提到一种做法，即开发测试和作战测试人员与开发人员并肩工作，从而使变更能够更早被发现和解决。“把开发测试与作战测试人员放到合适的位置，尤其是与开发团队在一起，我们就能加快这一进程。”
“ATO流程……其一，它不受项目办公室大多数人的控制，而一旦进入这一环节，确实会让一切戛然而止，”萨沃伊(Savoie)说，并呼吁对网络安全、信息技术安全和认证流程进行更广泛的审视。
乔布(Jobe)同样指出，安全环境是一个政策和决策可以更快推进的领域。
“我认为我们很可能可以快得多，”乔布说。“也许对采办系统内的人员进行一些沟通和教育可能会有所裨益。”
对比通蒂(Bitonti)而言，各军种与联盟伙伴之间的数据共享构成了另一项政策挑战。
“我们谈到非常希望作为联合部队行动，也与我们的联盟伙伴共同行动，但在关于我们可以和不能共享哪些数据的规则集方面，存在多重限制，也就是政策限制，”她说。
“目前，造成我们在共享数据方面一些困难的，实际上并不是技术障碍。而是政策障碍。”
在专题讨论结束时，Williams 把讨论拉回到空军部（DAF）的职责上，即以不断演变的作战所要求的速度交付能力。
“采办是一项作战职能，”Williams 说。“我们必须以作战相关性所需的速度，交付开放、有韧性、软件驱动的能力。”

作者：Senior Airman Malia Heemsoth

空军部长公共事务办公室

在空军部着力构建更加互联、更具韧性的“战斗网络”（Battle Network）之际，军方和业界领袖于9月15日在空军与太空军协会“空中、太空与网络大会”的一场专题讨论上，聚焦一个核心难题：如何更快地把作战能力送到作战人员手中。

“下一代战斗管理”专题讨论汇集了柯林斯航空航天公司的Elaine Bitonti、波音公司的退役Maj. Gen. Scott Jobe、SAIC公司的退役Col. Sean Lowe，以及埃尔比特美国公司的退役Maj. Luke Savoie。空军部负责指挥、控制、通信与战斗管理组合采办事务的Brig. Gen. Joshua Williams主持了讨论。

Williams在开场发言中强调，必须超越那些各自独立运行的系统。

Williams说：“空军部不会接受建立在封闭软件栈、黑箱硬件或受限数据接口之上的商业模式。政府必须拥有并管理技术基线，以确保快速迭代升级。”

在Savoie看来，这种开放性必须从体系架构延伸到在作战前沿运行的技术。

“你如何解决边缘的计算部分，从而使这些工具和互联网络在最前沿人员的循环中越来越靠前、越来越快地运行？”萨沃伊（Savoie）问道。

比通蒂（Bitonti）将这一挑战直接与部队中数据的移动联系起来。

“我认为，首先，你知道，从战斗管理角度看，我们明白关键在于我们如何移动数据，”比通蒂说，并解释称，将软件与硬件分离并创建灵活的通信架构，可以让系统在新需求出现时进行适应。

小组成员一致认为，这种灵活性只有在DAF能够快速测试和部署新能力时才有用。

“我认为，对政府而言，关键之一在于快速原型开发、演示，并确保我们拥有行业合作伙伴关系，”乔布（Jobe）说。“为了真正向DAF战斗网络或联合部队证明它，你必须走出去演示它，表明它是真实的。”

乔布指出最近的一个例子：一枚AMRAAM从一架MQ-28 Ghost Bat上发射，并在九个月内与一架E-7 Wedgetail和F/A-18 Hornet完成集成。

“因此，这只是我们所做众多事情中的一个例子，也是快速原型开发和进入实地演示能力的一个例子，”乔布说。

随后，小组转向研发与作战使用之间最大的障碍之一：测试、安全和认证。

洛(Lowe)描述了一个流程：软件会依次经过开发、安全合规、开发测试和作战测试，而每一次转段都可能增加数周或数月的时间。

“这就是为什么会出现数月乃至数年的延误，”洛(Lowe)说。他提到一种做法，即开发测试和作战测试人员与开发人员并肩工作，从而使变更能够更早被发现和解决。“把开发测试与作战测试人员放到合适的位置，尤其是与开发团队在一起，我们就能加快这一进程。”

“ATO流程……其一，它不受项目办公室大多数人的控制，而一旦进入这一环节，确实会让一切戛然而止，”萨沃伊(Savoie)说，并呼吁对网络安全、信息技术安全和认证流程进行更广泛的审视。

乔布(Jobe)同样指出，安全环境是一个政策和决策可以更快推进的领域。

“我认为我们很可能可以快得多，”乔布说。“也许对采办系统内的人员进行一些沟通和教育可能会有所裨益。”

对比通蒂(Bitonti)而言，各军种与联盟伙伴之间的数据共享构成了另一项政策挑战。

“我们谈到非常希望作为联合部队行动，也与我们的联盟伙伴共同行动，但在关于我们可以和不能共享哪些数据的规则集方面，存在多重限制，也就是政策限制，”她说。

“目前，造成我们在共享数据方面一些困难的，实际上并不是技术障碍。而是政策障碍。”

在专题讨论结束时，Williams 把讨论拉回到空军部（DAF）的职责上，即以不断演变的作战所要求的速度交付能力。

“采办是一项作战职能，”Williams 说。“我们必须以作战相关性所需的速度，交付开放、有韧性、软件驱动的能力。”

items.title: How we protected the UK and space in August 2026
items.summary: This report was issued in September 2026 and covers the time period 1 August 2026 to 31 August 2026 inclusive.
items.body:
August saw a reduced risk level to UK interests, with fewer uncontrolled re-entries, collision alerts, fragmentations and reduced space weather activity when compared with July.

All NSpOC warning and protection services were functioning throughout the period.

There was a 13% decrease in the number of objects re-entering Earth’s atmosphere monitored by NSpOC in August, when compared with the previous month.

Of the 54 objects that re-entered, 47 were satellites, six were rocket bodies and one was likely a piece of debris.

Collision avoidance analysis

Collision risks to UK-licensed satellites were 25% lower in August than in July and sat well below the 12-month rolling average.

Registered Space Objects (RSOs) analysis

The in-orbit population increased in August, with a net addition of 248 objects to the US Satellite Catalogue.

The number of Resident Space Objects (RSOs) reported may be subject to small adjustments over time as the way objects are tracked is refined. Figures in this report reflect the most current available data and may differ slightly from those published in previous months.

One fragmentation incident took place in August involving a satellite in Low Earth Orbit. Assessments are ongoing to understand how many pieces of debris were released into orbit.

Space weather analysis

Space weather activity was lower in August when compared with the previous month, consisting of some solar flares and geomagnetic storms.

The National Space Operations Centre combines and coordinates UK civil and military space domain awareness capabilities to enable operations, promote prosperity and protect UK interests in space and on Earth from space-related threats, risks and hazards.

items.title: The Pentagon asked industry how fast it could make more weapons. The numbers remain private.
items.author: Natalie Oliverio
items.summary: The Pentagon remains mum about defense contractors' plans to boost weapons production and delivery following a 21-day deadline for companies to send ideas.
items.body:
Twenty-six days after the Pentagon’s deadline for defense companies to propose faster weapons production, the Defense Department has not publicly disclosed how many companies responded or what production timelines they offered.

Deputy Defense Secretary Steve Feinberg gave industry leaders until Aug. 26 to submit plans for “significantly faster, more aggressive delivery schedules and/or increased production for critical capabilities,” according to his Aug. 5 memo.

Feinberg directed companies to identify ways to accelerate production and delivery, propose capital investments and facility expansions and explain how the Pentagon could enable higher production.

The memo identified 16 critical programs under consideration for accelerated production or increased procurement. The responses were intended to inform the department’s fiscal 2028 budget request.

The request came as the use of U.S. weapons during the Iran war put pressure on stocks of air-defense interceptors and other precision munitions.

U.S. inventories of Patriot interceptors had fallen from about 2,330 before the war to between 759 and 827 by the end of July, according to a Center for Strategic and International Studies analysis. THAAD stocks had fallen from 452 to between 234 and 278.

CSIS estimated production timelines of about 42 months for PAC-3 MSE interceptors and 53 months for THAAD interceptors.

The Pentagon did not respond to questions about how many companies responded to Feinberg’s request or whether the department had accepted or funded any of the proposals.

General Dynamics also declined to discuss its communications with the department.

“We are not able to comment on our communications with the Department of War,” a General Dynamics spokesman said.

Lockheed Martin, a major supplier of U.S. missile-defense systems, did not provide a specific production timeline in response to questions from Military Times.

“We continue to have dialogue with the U.S. government to deliver what the department is asking of us and our team is pushing to do even more, faster,” a Lockheed Martin spokesman said. “We’re making significant investments in our workforce, infrastructure and production capacity and working with key suppliers to accelerate delivery of the critical capabilities that strengthen America’s Arsenal of Freedom.”

Lockheed separately announced Thursday that it had received its first PAC-3 MSE housing components from GM Defense, 22 days after the companies signed a production contract. The company said the components, which can traditionally take months or years to produce, were manufactured using GM’s casting and machining capabilities.

Lockheed said it is investing $8 billion to $9 billion to expand munitions production, including new buildings, facility expansions and thousands of jobs at more than 20 U.S. sites. The company also said planned expansions will increase its munitions production and warehousing space by nearly 50%.

The company did not say whether those investments were submitted as part of Feinberg’s Aug. 5 request.

The Pentagon was already using framework agreements and contracts to accelerate production before Feinberg’s deadline.

On July 27, the department announced seven-year framework agreements intended to boost production of propulsion components for PAC-3 MSE and THAAD interceptors. L3Harris said its PAC-3 agreement would nearly triple production of certain propulsion products, while its THAAD agreement was intended to quadruple production of key propulsion components.

On Aug. 3, the defense department, in cooperation with Northrop Grumman and Lockheed Martin, announced two framework agreements to expand production capacity for critical PAC-3 and THAAD interceptor components. The agreements were intended to support the department’s goals of tripling PAC-3 production capacity and quadrupling THAAD production capacity.

On Aug. 14, DoD announced two separate framework agreements with Boeing and RTX to increase production of components for SM-3 Block IB and SM-3 Block IIA interceptors.

On Aug. 17, the Pentagon announced a $22.9 billion Navy contract with RTX to accelerate production of Tomahawk missiles.

On Aug. 31, five days after the industry deadline, the Pentagon announced additional seven-year multiyear procurement agreements with Lockheed Martin and General Dynamics designed to increase production quantities and accelerate delivery schedules for critical missile subcomponents supporting PAC-3 MSE and THAAD.

The Pentagon separately identified production goals of tripling PAC-3 MSE production capacity and quadrupling THAAD production capacity, with funding subject to annual appropriations from Congress.

The public announcements did not identify those agreements as resulting from companies’ responses to Feinberg’s Aug. 5 request.

What remains unclear is whether the 21-day exercise changed what the Pentagon plans to buy, how quickly it expects industry to deliver it or what additional funding and infrastructure the department will seek in its fiscal 2028 budget request.

Natalie Oliverio is an independent journalist and Navy veteran who covers military and veterans’ issues. Drawing on her experience as a talent executive and mentor, she writes about the policies, people and programs shaping the military community.
zhParas: 五角大楼要求国防企业提交加快武器生产方案的最后期限已过去26天，美国国防部仍未公开披露有多少家企业作出回应，也未说明它们提出了怎样的生产时间表。
根据国防部副部长史蒂夫·费恩伯格（Steve Feinberg）8月5日的备忘录，他要求军工企业领导人在8月26日前提交方案，以实现“显著更快、更具进取性的交付进度，和/或关键能力产量的提升”。
费恩伯格指示各企业找出加快生产与交付的途径，提出资本投资和设施扩建方案，并说明五角大楼可如何帮助其提高产量。
该备忘录列出了正在考虑加速生产或增加采购的16个关键项目。企业提交的回应旨在为国防部2028财年预算申请提供依据。
这一要求提出之际，伊朗战争中美制武器的使用给防空拦截弹及其他精确弹药的库存带来了压力。
根据战略与国际研究中心（CSIS）的分析，美国的Patriot拦截弹库存已从战前的约2330枚降至7月底的759至827枚。THAAD拦截弹库存则从452枚降至234至278枚。
战略与国际研究中心（CSIS）估计，PAC-3 MSE拦截弹的生产周期约为42个月，THAAD拦截弹约为53个月。
五角大楼未回应有关多少家企业响应了费恩伯格的要求、以及国防部是否采纳或资助了其中任何方案的提问。
通用动力公司也拒绝讨论其与该部的沟通情况。
“我们无法就与战争部的沟通情况置评，”通用动力公司一位发言人说。
洛克希德·马丁公司是美国导弹防御系统的主要供应商，该公司在回应《军事时报》的提问时未提供具体的生产时间表。
“我们继续与美国政府保持对话，以交付该部要求我们提供的东西，我们的团队正推动以更快速度完成更多工作，”洛克希德·马丁公司一位发言人说。“我们正在员工队伍、基础设施和产能方面进行重大投资，并与关键供应商合作，加快交付那些增强美国‘自由兵工厂’的关键能力。”
洛克希德公司周四另行宣布，已从通用汽车防务公司收到首批 PAC-3 MSE 壳体部件，此时距两家公司签署生产合同已过去22天。该公司表示，这些部件传统上可能需要数月甚至数年才能生产出来，此次是利用通用汽车的铸造和机加工能力制造的。
洛克希德公司表示，正在投资80亿至90亿美元扩大弹药生产，包括在美国20多个地点新建建筑、扩建设施并创造数千个工作岗位。该公司还表示，计划中的扩建将使其弹药生产和仓储空间增加近50%。
该公司没有说明这些投资是否作为范伯格（Feinberg）8月5日要求的一部分提交。
在范伯格设定的最后期限之前，五角大楼已经在利用框架协议和合同加速生产。
7月27日，国防部宣布了为期七年的框架协议，旨在提高 PAC-3 MSE 和 THAAD 拦截弹推进组件的产量。L3Harris 表示，其 PAC-3 协议将使某些推进产品的产量接近增至三倍，而其 THAAD 协议则旨在将关键推进组件的产量增至四倍。
8月3日，国防部与 Northrop Grumman 和 Lockheed Martin 合作，宣布了两项框架协议，以扩大关键 PAC-3 和 THAAD 拦截弹组件的产能。这些协议旨在支持国防部将 PAC-3 产能增至三倍、将 THAAD 产能增至四倍的目标。
8月14日，国防部宣布与 Boeing 和 RTX 分别达成两项框架协议，以提高 SM-3 Block IB 和 SM-3 Block IIA 拦截弹组件的产量。
8月17日，五角大楼宣布与 RTX 签订一份价值 229 亿美元的海军合同，以加快 Tomahawk 导弹的生产。
8月31日，即业界截止日期五天后，五角大楼宣布与 Lockheed Martin 和 General Dynamics 达成额外的七年期多年采购协议，旨在提高支持 PAC-3 MSE 和 THAAD 的关键导弹子组件的产量并加快交付进度。
五角大楼另行确定了将 PAC-3 MSE 产能增至三倍、将 THAAD 产能增至四倍的生产目标，相关资金须经国会年度拨款。
公开声明并未说明这些协议是各公司回应范伯格（Feinberg）8月5日请求的结果。
仍不清楚的是，这场为期21天的演习是否改变了五角大楼计划采购的内容、其期望业界交付的速度，或国防部将在2028财年预算申请中寻求哪些额外资金和基础设施。
娜塔莉·奥利维里奥（Natalie Oliverio）是一名独立记者、海军退伍军人，报道军事与退伍军人事务。凭借其作为人才高管和导师的经验，她撰文探讨塑造军人社群的政策、人物与项目。

在范伯格设定的最后期限之前，五角大楼已经在利用框架协议和合同加速生产。

7月27日，国防部宣布了为期七年的框架协议，旨在提高 PAC-3 MSE 和 THAAD 拦截弹推进组件的产量。L3Harris 表示，其 PAC-3 协议将使某些推进产品的产量接近增至三倍，而其 THAAD 协议则旨在将关键推进组件的产量增至四倍。

8月3日，国防部与 Northrop Grumman 和 Lockheed Martin 合作，宣布了两项框架协议，以扩大关键 PAC-3 和 THAAD 拦截弹组件的产能。这些协议旨在支持国防部将 PAC-3 产能增至三倍、将 THAAD 产能增至四倍的目标。

8月14日，国防部宣布与 Boeing 和 RTX 分别达成两项框架协议，以提高 SM-3 Block IB 和 SM-3 Block IIA 拦截弹组件的产量。

8月17日，五角大楼宣布与 RTX 签订一份价值 229 亿美元的海军合同，以加快 Tomahawk 导弹的生产。

8月31日，即业界截止日期五天后，五角大楼宣布与 Lockheed Martin 和 General Dynamics 达成额外的七年期多年采购协议，旨在提高支持 PAC-3 MSE 和 THAAD 的关键导弹子组件的产量并加快交付进度。

五角大楼另行确定了将 PAC-3 MSE 产能增至三倍、将 THAAD 产能增至四倍的生产目标，相关资金须经国会年度拨款。

公开声明并未说明这些协议是各公司回应范伯格（Feinberg）8月5日请求的结果。

仍不清楚的是，这场为期21天的演习是否改变了五角大楼计划采购的内容、其期望业界交付的速度，或国防部将在2028财年预算申请中寻求哪些额外资金和基础设施。

娜塔莉·奥利维里奥（Natalie Oliverio）是一名独立记者、海军退伍军人，报道军事与退伍军人事务。凭借其作为人才高管和导师的经验，她撰文探讨塑造军人社群的政策、人物与项目。

items.title: US watching Chinese marine presence off Alaska, Arctic Coast Guard chief says
items.author: Gwladys Fouche, Reuters
items.summary: The United States is watching China’s presence in its Arctic zone “very closely” amid increasing concerns, a senior U.S. Arctic military official said.
items.body:
The United States is watching China’s presence in its Arctic zone “very closely” amid concerns regarding the security of the U.S. homeland, a senior U.S. Arctic military official said.

So far in 2026, four Chinese research vessels have conducted work offshore in the U.S. Arctic, compared to a total of five in 2025, Rear Adm. Bob Little, commander of the U.S. Coast Guard’s Arctic District, told Reuters.

The Chinese ships sailed in the maritime zones off the U.S. state of Alaska, including the Aleutian Islands, into the Bering Strait and as far north as the North Pole, he said during a visit to Oslo to speak at a conference on Arctic security.

“Where I have responsibility, interest and concern is when they are operating in and around U.S. sovereign space,” said Little.

“So inside of our exclusive economic zones, or over our extended continental shelf, we certainly have a security concern. And so those are the types of activities that we see that we’re watching very closely.”

The ships remained in international waters but had not notified the U.S. of their presence in advance through diplomatic channels, as would be the usual practice.

“When we challenge them and query them as to the purpose of their activities, their response typically is either ‘we are conducting operations in international waters’ or ‘we are conducting scientific research,’” he said.

The concern is two-fold. One is that China may be involved in scientific research focused on the mineral exploitation of the seabed in an area that belongs to the U.S., Little said.

The other is that these vessels conduct activity that might “provide [the Chinese] with a military advantage or pose a security threat to the United States,” said Little, whose area of operations is nearly as vast as Europe.

China, which calls itself a “near-Arctic” state and wants to create a “Polar Silk Road” in the Arctic, has stepped up its presence in the polar region in recent years, sometimes in joint operations with Russia and sometimes alone.

While in Norway, Little discussed with international colleagues how they were dealing with similar activities by Russian research vessels.

“Whether it’s the Barents (Sea) or the Baltic (Sea), it’s easy to find examples of hybrid threats and activities,” he said.

“So I certainly watch that very carefully, because it’s the same nation-state that’s my neighbor on the western side of the Arctic,” he said, referring to Russia.

Moscow denies that its research vessels conduct illegal activity or that it poses any threat to U.S. interests.
zhParas: 一名美国高级北极事务军官表示，出于对美国本土安全的担忧，美国正在“非常密切地”关注中国在其北极区域的存在。
美国海岸警卫队北极区司令、Rear Adm. 鲍勃·利特尔（Bob Little）告诉路透社，截至2026年迄今，已有四艘中国科考船在美国北极近海开展作业，而2025年全年共有五艘。
他说，这些中国船只航行在阿拉斯加州近海海域，包括阿留申群岛，进入白令海峡，并一路向北到达北极点；他是在访问奥斯陆、出席一场北极安全会议并发表讲话期间作此表示的。
“我负有责任、利益和担忧的地方，是当它们在美国主权空间及其周边活动时，”利特尔说。
“因此，在我们的专属经济区内，或在我们扩展大陆架上方，我们当然存在安全担忧。所以，这些正是我们看到并正在非常密切关注的各类活动。”
这些船只一直停留在国际水域，但未按惯例通过外交渠道提前就其存在通知美国。
“当我们对他们的活动目的提出质疑和询问时，他们的答复通常是‘我们正在国际水域开展行动’，或者‘我们正在进行科学研究’，”他说。
这种担忧有两方面。利特尔说，其一是，中国可能参与以属于美国区域的海底矿产开采为重点的科学研究。
另一个是，这些船只从事的活动可能“为中国提供军事优势，或对美国构成安全威胁”，利特尔（Little）说。他的作战区域几乎与欧洲一样辽阔。
中国自称“近北极”国家，并希望在北极打造“极地丝绸之路”，近年来已加强在极地地区的存在，有时与俄罗斯联合行动，有时单独行动。
在挪威期间，利特尔与国际同行讨论了如何应对俄罗斯科考船的类似活动。
“无论是巴伦支海还是波罗的海，都很容易找到混合威胁和活动的例子，”他说。
“所以我当然会非常仔细地关注这一点，因为正是同一个民族国家在北极西侧与我为邻，”他说。他指的是俄罗斯。
莫斯科否认其科考船从事非法活动，也否认对美国利益构成任何威胁。

items.title: Veterans News and Communications Hub
items.summary: The Hub enables forces-friendly organisations across all sectors to showcase the continued value of the UK’s highly skilled veteran community.
items.body:
This collaborative project is delivered by Defence Relationship Management and Cobseo (The Confederation of Service Charities). The Hub enables forces-friendly organisations across all sectors to showcase the continued value of the UK’s highly skilled veteran community.

National webinar series connects Armed Forces community with health and social care careers

Veterans, reservists, Service leavers and military family members are invited to a three-part webinar series showcasing accessible career routes across health and social care.

Taking place from 20 to 22 October 2026, Pathways into Health and Social Care, hosted by the Forces Employment Charity, will connect the Armed Forces community with forces-friendly employers in the NHS, social care, and pharmaceutical and healthcare support sectors.

Read more about the webinar

A letter from Scotty’s founder and chief executive

Nikki Scott and Stuart Robinson have written a letter explaining the future of Scotty’s, taking effect immediately.

Scotty’s, The Military Bereavement Charity , the charity supporting children bereaved by military deaths, is expanding its support to include adults affected by military-connected bereavement, including parents, spouses, partners, siblings and adult children. Support for children and young people will continue unchanged.

Read the full announcement

LGBT veterans have 100 days left to apply for financial recognition

LGBT veterans can apply for restorative measures, including financial recognition payments of up to £70,000

non-financial recognition available includes an official letter of apology, replacement service items and a restoration ceremony

nearly £60m has been paid to over 1,800 veterans so far, but more may be eligible

Veterans discharged or impacted by the ban on LGBT personnel in the armed forces have 100 days left to apply for the government’s restorative measures.

The measures were introduced following an independent review on the impact of the ban on LGBT personnel serving in the UK Armed Forces between 1967 and 2000.

The government is now issuing a final call to eligible veterans before the application deadline closes on 12 December.

What is a veteran?

Veterans are defined as anyone who has served for at least one day in His Majesty’s Armed Forces (Regular or Reserve) or Merchant Mariners who have seen duty on legally defined military operations. There are currently 2.4 million veterans in Great Britain.

There are 2.4 million veterans in Great Britain. 40% of veterans are 16-64 years old. The percentage of working age veterans is set to increase to 44% by 2028. 60% of veterans are over 65. 75% of veterans own their home or have a mortgage. It is estimated that 3% to 6% of those sleeping rough have served in the Armed Forces. 75% are healthy, 17% have fair health and 8% have bad health. Want to learn more? Tune in to our ‘being forces friendly’ podcast’.

Listen to our team of veterans talk about their experiences : transitioning from the UK Armed Forces and what the word ‘veteran’ means to them.

Office for Veterans’ Affairs (OVA)

The Office for Veterans’ Affairs (OVA) is part of the MOD , leading on the government’s policy on veterans. The OVA work with devolved administrations in Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, local governments, charities and businesses to provide support to veterans when they need it. They offer programs and resources to help veterans get into better employment and continue making great contributions to society after leaving the armed forces.

OP ASCEND – careers after Service

Veterans in the UK now have access to OP ASCEND, which aims to improve the career support available to veterans, regardless of when they left Service.

Sign up to Op ASCEND

This strategy sets the government’s new vision for veterans. In doing so we are clear about the security and growth challenges we face – and our plans to respond to them as set out in the Strategic Defence Review . This strategy challenges the whole of society to think differently about those who have served in the armed forces, their offer and their potential.

Veterans Strategy - GOV.UK

The Reed Group

The Reed Group has created an internal Armed Forces Veterans and Reservists Group (AFVR) community.

The AFVR Group’s benefits include:

offering employees a support group of people with similar experiences

recreating a sense of camaraderie that they may be missing from their time in the forces

offering an optional buddy system for mentoring new staff, especially when this is a member’s first civilian job

sharing Armed Forces events, news and experiences

Their working group will also hold group-wide talks to raise awareness for employing the Armed Forces Community, the benefits they bring to employers, and how they can be supported. Reed opens group talks to external stakeholders to host and bring their expertise, and they welcome anyone who would be interested in attending. If you would like to participate, email the Reed Armed Forces Community at ArmedForces.Community@reed.com .

The Forces Employment Charity

The Forces Employment Charity stands by ex-Forces personnel through a range of programmes and practical support. Supporting anyone who has served at least one day in His Majesty’s Regular Armed Forces, or Merchant Mariners who have seen duty on legally defined military operations. Support is delivered by experienced advisors, many of whom also served. The Forces Employment Charity advisors are committed to helping veterans succeed through their working lives.

The Forces Employment Charity programmes provide a range of practical tools and advice to help veterans use their military skills to stand out from the crowd.

The support provided includes:

advice on career choices

researching the job market

advice on training

recommendations for courses and education

support with writing a CV

advice on interview techniques

expert industry knowledge and updates

events and employment fairs

For more information visit The Forces Employment Charity .

The Poppy Factory

The Poppy Factory helps veterans and their families to make progress on the path to employment. The charity’s Veteran and Family Services team are based regionally throughout England and Wales, offering regular one-to-one contact with veterans and their families. They can help with CV writing, job search, support with training, exploring new opportunities, interview preparation, overcoming obstacles and in-work support.

Veterans Employment Service : If you’ve served in the Armed Forces and you have a health condition, The Poppy Factory’s Veterans Employment Service can help you on your journey towards employment. Specialist consultants are based regionally across England and Wales, offering local knowledge and regular one-to-one contact.

Fighting With Pride (FWP) is a military charity, created on the 20th anniversary of the complete lifting of the ban on LGBTQ+ service – the ‘Gay Ban’.

Initially Fighting With Pride was created to support those affected by the ‘Gay Ban’ lifted on 12th January 2000, where thousands of LGBTQ+ service personnel were removed or forced from service and abandoned, having served with pride. Defence Medical Welfare Service

Defence Medical Welfare Service (DMWS) improve physical and mental health, and social and emotional wellbeing through professional welfare support to the armed forces community (serving, reservists, veterans), The Merchant Navy, the military bereaved, and their families/carers.

They also support other frontline services including the police counselling and structured professional support. These sessions are focussed on ensuring the right support is in place to maintain a healthy level of wellbeing, promoting resilience and supporting staff to stay at their best.

They provide a range of clinical and non-clinical interventions, through times of stress and uncertainty, during medical treatment at the hospital bedside, back home, and in the community or on deployed operations in challenging frontline environments. They support improvements in physical and mental wellbeing, housing and finance issues, family relationships, substance misuse, social isolation and more.

The Veterans’ Foundation was set up in 2016 to raise funds to help improve the lives of all within the armed forces community who need it. 这些措施是在一项独立审查之后推出的，该审查针对 1967 年至 2000 年间禁止 LGBT 人员在英国武装部队服役所造成的影响。

什么是退伍军人？
退伍军人被定义为在国王陛下武装部队（正规军或预备役）服役至少一天的人，或在法定军事行动中执行过任务的商船船员。目前大不列颠有240万退伍军人。
大不列颠有240万退伍军人。40%的退伍军人年龄在16至64岁之间。处于工作年龄的退伍军人比例预计到2028年将增至44%。60%的退伍军人年龄超过65岁。75%的退伍军人拥有自有住房或背负住房贷款。据估计，3%至6%的露宿街头者曾在武装部队服役。75%健康状况良好，17%健康状况一般，8%健康状况不佳。想了解更多？请收听我们的“being forces friendly”播客。
聆听我们的退伍军人团队讲述他们的经历：从英国武装部队过渡，以及“退伍军人”一词对他们意味着什么。

LGBT 退伍军人申请经济补偿的期限还剩 100 天

LGBT 退伍军人可申请补偿措施，包括最高 £70,000 的经济补偿金

可获得的非经济性补偿包括正式道歉信、补发的服役物品以及恢复名誉仪式

迄今已向 1,800 多名退伍军人支付近 £60m，但可能还有更多人符合条件

因武装部队对 LGBT 人员的禁令而被退伍或受影响的退伍军人，申请政府补偿措施的期限还剩 100 天。

这些措施是在一项独立审查之后推出的，该审查针对 1967 年至 2000 年间禁止 LGBT 人员在英国武装部队服役所造成的影响。

政府现向符合条件的退伍军人发出最后呼吁，申请截止日期 12 月 12 日即将到来。

什么是退伍军人？

退伍军人被定义为在国王陛下武装部队（正规军或预备役）服役至少一天的人，或在法定军事行动中执行过任务的商船船员。目前大不列颠有240万退伍军人。

大不列颠有240万退伍军人。40%的退伍军人年龄在16至64岁之间。处于工作年龄的退伍军人比例预计到2028年将增至44%。60%的退伍军人年龄超过65岁。75%的退伍军人拥有自有住房或背负住房贷款。据估计，3%至6%的露宿街头者曾在武装部队服役。75%健康状况良好，17%健康状况一般，8%健康状况不佳。想了解更多？请收听我们的“being forces friendly”播客。

聆听我们的退伍军人团队讲述他们的经历：从英国武装部队过渡，以及“退伍军人”一词对他们意味着什么。

退伍军人事务办公室（OVA）

退伍军人事务办公室（OVA）是国防部（MOD）的一部分，牵头负责政府的退伍军人政策。OVA与苏格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰的分权政府、地方政府、慈善机构和企业合作，在退伍军人需要时为其提供支持。他们提供项目和资源，帮助退伍军人获得更好的就业，并在离开武装部队后继续为社会作出重大贡献。

OP ASCEND——服役后的职业发展

英国退伍军人现在可以使用OP ASCEND，该项目旨在改善退伍军人可获得的职业支持，无论他们何时退役。

报名参加 Op ASCEND

该战略确立了政府面向退役军人的新愿景。为此，我们明确认识到所面临的安全与增长挑战，以及我们在《战略防务评估》中提出的应对计划。该战略要求全社会以不同方式看待曾在武装部队服役的人员、他们所能提供的价值以及他们的潜力。

退役军人战略 - GOV.UK

里德集团

里德集团创建了一个内部武装部队退伍军人和预备役人员小组（AFVR）社群。

AFVR 小组的益处包括：

为员工提供一个由经历相似者组成的支持小组

重建他们可能怀念的军中战友情谊

提供可选的伙伴制度，为新员工提供指导，尤其是在这是该成员第一份文职工作的情况下。

分享武装部队的活动、新闻和经历。

其工作组还将举行全集团范围的讲座，以提高对雇用武装部队社区的认识，宣传他们为雇主带来的益处，以及如何为他们提供支持。Reed 将集团讲座开放给外部利益相关方，由其主办并分享专业知识，并欢迎任何有兴趣参加的人。如果您想参加，请发送电子邮件至 Reed 武装部队社区：ArmedForces.Community@reed.com。

部队就业慈善机构

部队就业慈善机构通过一系列项目和实际支持，为退役部队人员提供帮助。为任何在国王陛下正规武装部队服役至少一天的人，或在法律界定的军事行动中执行过任务的商船船员提供支持。支持由经验丰富的顾问提供，其中许多人本人也服过役。部队就业慈善机构的顾问致力于帮助退伍军人在职业生涯中取得成功。

部队就业慈善机构的项目提供一系列实用工具和建议，帮助退伍军人运用其军事技能脱颖而出。

所提供的支持包括：

职业选择建议

研究就业市场

培训建议

课程与教育推荐

协助撰写简历

面试技巧建议

专家行业知识与最新动态

活动与招聘会

如需了解更多信息，请访问 The Forces Employment Charity。

虞美人花工厂

虞美人花工厂帮助退伍军人及其家属在就业道路上取得进展。该慈善机构的退伍军人及家庭服务团队分布在英格兰和威尔士各地，定期与退伍军人及其家属进行一对一联系。他们可以在简历撰写、求职、培训支持、探索新机会、面试准备、克服障碍以及在职支持方面提供帮助。

退伍军人就业服务：如果你曾在武装部队服役且患有健康问题，虞美人花工厂的退伍军人就业服务可以在你迈向就业的过程中提供帮助。专业顾问分布在英格兰和威尔士各地，提供本地知识和定期一对一联系。

家属就业服务：如果你年满18岁，并且你的职业生涯受到家庭成员在军队服役的影响，家属就业服务可以帮助你建立一个更适合你自身情况和愿望的更光明职业未来。专业且灵活的支持通过电话、电子邮件和视频通话提供。

Navigator：通过虞美人花工厂的Navigator服务，可获得长达六个月的专业一对一支持。如果你是退伍军人，它可以帮助你通过爱好、活动以及培训或志愿服务机会，采取切实步骤迈向就业。请查看网站，了解Navigator在哪些地区可用。

访问虞美人花工厂网站

超过14,500家组织已承诺改善军人及其家属的生活。

自2011年以来，《武装部队公约》一直是一项承诺：作为一个社会，我们将承认，那些正在或曾经在武装部队服役的人及其家属应当得到公平和尊重对待。

了解更多关于军队友好型雇主的信息

退伍军人与小企业

退伍军人：商业的一股力量

X-Forces Enterprise（XFE）与小企业联合会（FSB）在过去几年中开展了广泛合作，其开端是一份关于退役军人商业格局的富有洞见的报告：《商业的一股力量》。

该报告强调了英国退伍军人群体对小企业部门的贡献，在大不列颠，6%的小企业由退伍军人所有。然而，报告显示这一比例仍有提升空间；更多退伍军人在大不列颠数百万家小企业中创办、发展或工作，将使个人、企业和社区受益。

支持退伍军人及其家属——OVA目录

退伍军人事务办公室（OVA）与国防部（MOD）推出了“支持退伍军人及其家属”服务，取代了“退伍军人门户”。

这些服务包括在身心健康、财务、就业、住房和社会照护方面提供支持。

为骄傲而战

为骄傲而战（FWP）是一家军事慈善机构，成立于LGBTQ+服役禁令——“同性恋禁令”——全面解除20周年之际。

最初，为骄傲而战的创建是为了支持受2000年1月12日解除的“同性恋禁令”影响的人——在该禁令下，数千名LGBTQ+军人被除名或被迫退役并遭抛弃，尽管他们曾自豪地服役。如今，FWP还支持现役人员及其家属，以及如今离开军队的人，帮助他们成为LGBTQ+武装部队群体中自豪的一员。

联系为骄傲而战

国防医疗福利服务

国防医疗福利服务（DMWS）通过专业的福利支持，改善武装部队群体（现役人员、预备役人员、退伍军人）、商船队、军人遗属及其家属/照护者的身心健康，以及社交和情绪健康。

他们还支持其他一线服务，包括警察心理咨询和结构化的专业支持。这些课程侧重于确保提供适当的支持，以维持健康的福祉水平，增强韧性，并帮助工作人员保持最佳状态。

在压力与不确定时期，在医院病床旁、回到家中、社区中，或在充满挑战的前线环境中执行部署任务期间接受医疗救治时，他们提供一系列临床和非临床干预。他们支持在身心健康、住房和财务问题、家庭关系、物质滥用、社会孤立等方面作出改善。

如需了解更多信息或获取支持，请联系他们：

电子邮件：referrals@dmws.org.uk 网站：www.dmws.org.uk

武装部队与退伍军人早餐俱乐部

武装部队与退伍军人早餐俱乐部（AFVBC）现在是英国最大的退伍军人组织，会员人数每周都在增长。

AFVBC 在全国拥有 400 多个俱乐部，在海外设有 15 个，致力于终结退伍军人的社会孤立。这些俱乐部将同英国武装部队有联系的人们聚集在一起，并提供重温往事、分享故事以及融入一个多数人在离开武装部队后所怀念的社群的机会。

AFVBC 还在英国各地的 HM 监狱中开展五个试点项目，在 HM 监狱内构建一个武装部队社群。这些试点项目有助于目前处于刑事司法系统中的退伍军人进行社会交往、康复，并为他们建立支持体系。

查找您当地的 AFVBC

皇家英国退伍军人协会（RBL）

作为该国最大的武装部队慈善机构，皇家英国退伍军人协会为该群体提供广泛支持。服役仅一天后，他们就会提供支持，并在服役结束后的人生中长期持续提供支持。

皇家英国退伍军人协会的在线知识库可以帮助您了解该慈善机构提供哪些支持，以及作为曾服役人员您可能有资格获得哪些支持。

进一步了解皇家英国退伍军人协会

部队养老金协会

部队养老金协会是一个独立的、非营利性的会员资助组织。他们为整个武装部队群体充当养老金监督机构，并提高人们对武装部队养老金复杂性和福利的认识。该协会帮助其成员就武装部队养老金做出更好、充分知情的决定，并为武装部队养老金计划的成员及其伴侣提供个性化养老金指导。

他们还与政府合作，确保您的养老金得到适当发放，并举办一系列巡回宣讲和其他教育活动，以更好地让武装部队群体为各种养老金事务做好准备。

2025年未领取养老金宣传活动

英国盲人退伍军人协会

Blind Veterans UK 是全国性慈善机构，服务于有严重视力丧失的退伍男女军人。

该慈善机构帮助盲人退伍军人学习重要的生活技能，并为他们提供独立生活所需的康复、培训和支持。

退伍军人与权力下放地区

退伍军人专员代表居住在北爱尔兰的退伍军人及其家属，就包括医疗、住房、福利和社会交往在内的一系列问题独立发声。

有关北爱尔兰退伍军人专员的更多信息

北爱尔兰退伍军人简报

北爱尔兰退伍军人专员办公室的简报已更新，内容包括有关 Valour 的新闻、纪念 Op TELIC 的内容，以及来自退伍军人社区的更多最新动态。

在北爱尔兰退伍军人专员办公室阅读该简报

苏格兰退伍军人专员致力于改善苏格兰退伍军人及其家属的成果与机会。这包括影响政策制定者，以解决权力下放的公共服务中所需的任何变革。

有关苏格兰退伍军人专员的更多信息

在 X 上关注退伍军人事务处

补助金与资助

武装契约基金信托

武装部队契约基金信托会（下称信托会）资助相关项目，以支持国家履行对现役人员、退伍军人及其家属的契约承诺。

信托会是一家慈善机构，并被归类为非部级公共机构（NDPB）。它负责管理武装部队契约基金，该基金每年金额达1000万英镑。

武装部队契约基金有4个目标：

1. 为退伍军人提供非核心医疗服务 2. 消除家庭生活障碍 3. 支持需要帮助的现役人员和退伍军人 4. 促进军队与民间社区融合，让武装部队群体能够以公民身份参与其中

了解已获得拨款资助的组织

慈善机构和慈善组织越来越难以筹集到继续开展其至关重要、往往能改变命运的工作所需的资金，因而依赖退伍军人基金会提供拨款支持。正因如此，退役少将戴维·肖（David Shaw）于2016年创办了退伍军人基金会，也正因如此，该基金会已发展成为英国领先的军事慈善机构之一。
